armyRules.name: Power from Pain
armyRules.text:
All **^^Drukhari^^** units have a Pain ability, tagged with the word 'Pain'. Pain abilities only apply to a unit while it is Empowered. If your Army Faction is **^^Drukhari^^**, you can Empower units from your army with Pain abilities by spending Pain tokens (see below).

**GAINING PAIN TOKENS**

If your Army Faction is **^^Drukhari^^**, you gain Pain tokens as follows:
■ 1 Pain token at the start of your Command phase.
■ 1 Pain token each time an enemy unit is destroyed.
■ 1 Pain token each time an enemy unit fails a Battle-shock test.

Each time you gain a Pain token, keep it to one side – this is your Pain token pool. Each time you spend a Pain token, reduce your Pain token pool by the same amount.

**EMPOWERED THROUGH PAIN**

Each Pain ability will state when you can spend Pain tokens to Empower that unit. When you do, until the end of the phase, that unit is Empowered and all Pain abilities it has take effect. While an Attached unit is Empowered, the Pain abilities of all Leader and Bodyguard units in that unit take effect - you do not need to spend additional Pain tokens to activate each of those Pain abilities.

armyRules.name: Corsairs and Travelling Players
armyRules.text:
If your Army Faction is **DRUKHARI**, you can include **HARLEQUINS** and **ANHRATHE** units in your army, even though they do not have the **DRUKHARI** Faction keyword. The combined points value of **HARLEQUINS** and/or **ANHRATHE** units you can include in your army depends on the battle size, as follows:
- Incursion: Up to 250 pts
- Strike Force: Up to 500 pts
- Onslaught: Up to 750 pts
No **HARLEQUINS** or **ANHRATHE** models included in your army in this way can be your WARLORD, and they cannot be given Enhancements.

rule.name: Callous Competition
rule.text:
At the start of the battle, Drukhari units from your army are winning the wager.
Each time a Drukhari unit from your army destroys an enemy unit, Drukhari units from your army are winning the wager.
Each time a Harlequins unit from your army destroys an enemy unit, Harlequin units from your army are winning the wager.
While Drukhari units from your army are winning the wager, Harlequin units from your army are losing the wager, and vice versa.
Each time a Drukhari or Harlequins model from your army makes an attack, if that model’s unit is winning the wager, re-roll a Hit roll of 1. If that model's unit is losing the wager, re‑roll a Hit roll of 1 and re‑roll a Wound roll of 1 instead.

Malicious Frenzy.name: MALICIOUS FRENZY
Malicious Frenzy.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
Malicious Frenzy.target: One DRUKHARI or HARLEQUINS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
Malicious Frenzy.effect: Select [LETHAL HITS] or [SUSTAINED HITS 1]. Until the end of the phase, weapons equipped by models in your unit have the selected ability.
Malicious Frenzy.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.

TARGET: One DRUKHARI or HARLEQUINS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.

EFFECT: Select [LETHAL HITS] or [SUSTAINED HITS 1]. Until the end of the phase, weapons equipped by models in your unit have the selected ability.
Malicious Frenzy.flavour: Jealous competition descends into frenzied carnage as the kill count climbs higher and the intoxicating screams of the dying fill the air.

Fateful Role.name: FATEFUL ROLE
Fateful Role.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Fateful Role.target: One DRUKHARI or HARLEQUINS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Fateful Role.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6, adding 1 to the result if that unit is losing the wager: on a 4+, do not remove it from play. That destroyed model can fight after the attacking model’s unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.
Fateful Role.text:
WHEN: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One DRUKHARI or HARLEQUINS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6, adding 1 to the result if that unit is losing the wager: on a 4+, do not remove it from play. That destroyed model can fight after the attacking model’s unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.
Fateful Role.flavour: These warriors are so absorbed by their desire to win the wager that they risk death to land their killing blows.

Murderer’s Circus.name: MURDERER’S CIRCUS
Murderer’s Circus.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Murderer’s Circus.target: One DRUKHARI or HARLEQUINS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Murderer’s Circus.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.
Murderer’s Circus.text:
WHEN: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One DRUKHARI or HARLEQUINS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.
Murderer’s Circus.flavour: In bounding leaps and graceful pirouettes, the cavalcade of capricious killers bounds through hails of fire, cackling gleefully as they come.

Shorten the Odds.name: SHORTEN THE ODDS
Shorten the Odds.when: Your Movement phase, just after a DRUKHARI or HARLEQUINS unit from your army has Advanced.
Shorten the Odds.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.
Shorten the Odds.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase, just after a DRUKHARI or HARLEQUINS unit from your army has Advanced.

TARGET: That unit.

EFFECT: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.
Shorten the Odds.flavour: Having selected their victims, these killers strive to complete the kill with speed and brutality whilst moving ever closer to winning their macabre wager.

Scintillating Tempo.name: SCINTILLATING TEMPO
Scintillating Tempo.when: Your Movement phase or your Charge phase, just after a DRUKHARI or HARLEQUINS unit from your army is selected to make a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move, is set up on the battlefield, or declares a charge.
Scintillating Tempo.effect: Until the end of the turn, enemy units cannot use the Fire Overwatch Stratagem to shoot at your unit.
Scintillating Tempo.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase or your Charge phase, just after a DRUKHARI or HARLEQUINS unit from your army is selected to make a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move, is set up on the battlefield, or declares a charge.

TARGET: That unit.

EFFECT: Until the end of the turn, enemy units cannot use the Fire Overwatch Stratagem to shoot at your unit.
Scintillating Tempo.flavour: Commorrite or Harlequin, these lithe combatants move with stunning speed, darting in and out of firing lines before their foes can raise their weapons.

Dance Macabre.name: DANCE MACABRE
Dance Macabre.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
Dance Macabre.target: One DRUKHARI INFANTRY or HARLEQUINS INFANTRY unit from your army that is within 8" of that enemy unit.
Dance Macabre.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to D6". If your unit is currently losing the wager, it can make a Normal move of up to 6" instead.
Dance Macabre.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.

TARGET: One DRUKHARI INFANTRY or HARLEQUINS INFANTRY unit from your army that is within 8" of that enemy unit.

EFFECT: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to D6". If your unit is currently losing the wager, it can make a Normal move of up to 6" instead.
Dance Macabre.flavour: The saedath’s victims become unwitting partners in a frantic dance of ghastly slaughter.

enhancements.text: ^^**Harlequins**^^ or ^^**Drukhari**^^ model only. In the Declare Battle Formations step, if the bearer starts the battle embarked within a ^^**Dedicated Transport**^^, that ^^**Dedicated Transport**^^ has the Scouts 9" ability.

enhancements.name: - Webway Walker
enhancements.text: ^^**Harlequins**^^ or ^^**Drukhari**^^ model only. Models in the bearer’s unit have the Deep Strike ability. Each time the bearer’s unit is set up on the battlefield using the Deep Strike ability, if that unit is currently losing the wager, until the end of the turn, you can re‑roll Charge rolls made for that unit.

enhancements.name: - Reaper’s Cowl
enhancements.text: ^^**Harlequins**^^ model only. Models in the bearer’s unit have the Stealth and Infiltrators abilities.

enhancements.name: - Conductor of Torment
enhancements.text:
^^**Drukhari**^^ model only. In your Command phase, you can do one of the following:
■ If your ^^**Drukhari**^^ units are currently losing the wager, you can gain 1 Pain token. If you do, ^^**Drukhari**^^ units from your army are now winning the wager.
■ If your ^^**Drukhari**^^ units are currently winning the wager, you can discard 1 Pain token. If you do, ^^**Harlequins**^^ units from your army are now winning the wager.

rule.name: Alliance of Agony
rule.text:
At the start of the battle, you gain 2 Pain tokens for each of the following combinations your army contains (these do not need to be in the same Attached unit):
■ One or more **^^Archon^^** models and one or more **^^Kabalite Warriors^^** units.
■ One or more **^^Succubus^^** models and one or more **^^Wyches^^** units.
■ One or more **^^Haemonculus^^** models and one or more **^^Wracks^^** units.

Designer’s Note: These are all cumulative, so if your army contains at least one of all of the combinations listed above, you start the battle with 6 Pain tokens.

Insensible to Pain.name: INSENSIBLE TO PAIN
Insensible to Pain.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Insensible to Pain.target: One HAEMONCULUS COVENS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Insensible to Pain.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack is allocated to a model in your unit, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of that attack.
Insensible to Pain.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One HAEMONCULUS COVENS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack is allocated to a model in your unit, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of that attack.
Insensible to Pain.flavour: The twisted creations of the haemonculus covens are uncaring of all but the most mortal injuries.

Fighting Shadows.name: FIGHTING SHADOWS
Fighting Shadows.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Fighting Shadows.target: One DRUKHARI unit from your army (excluding HAEMONCULUS COVENS units) that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Fighting Shadows.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.
Fighting Shadows.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One DRUKHARI unit from your army (excluding HAEMONCULUS COVENS units) that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.
Fighting Shadows.flavour: Even attempting to strike the Drukhari is like trying to lay a blade to smoke, so sly and swift are they.

Instinctive Spite.name: INSTINCTIVE SPITE
Instinctive Spite.when: Start of your Shooting phase or the start of the Fight phase.
Instinctive Spite.target: Up to two DRUKHARI BATTLELINE units from your army, or one other DRUKHARI unit from your army.
Instinctive Spite.effect: You can spend 1 Pain token. Until the end of the phase, each time a model in each of those units makes an attack that targets an enemy unit that is Below Half-strength, add 1 to the Hit roll. If you spent 1 Pain token, add 1 to the Wound roll as well.
Instinctive Spite.text:
WHEN: Start of your Shooting phase or the start of the Fight phase.

TARGET: Up to two DRUKHARI BATTLELINE units from your army, or one other DRUKHARI unit from your army.

EFFECT: You can spend 1 Pain token. Until the end of the phase, each time a model in each of those units makes an attack that targets an enemy unit that is Below Half-strength, add 1 to the Hit roll. If you spent 1 Pain token, add 1 to the Wound roll as well.
Instinctive Spite.flavour: It is hardwired into the Drukhari psyche to prey upon weakened and suffering victims.

Dark Harvest.name: DARK HARVEST
Dark Harvest.target: Up to two WRACKS units from your army, or one other DRUKHARI unit from your army.
Dark Harvest.effect: Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in each of those units have the [LETHAL HITS] ability.
Dark Harvest.text:
WHEN: Start of the Fight phase.

TARGET: Up to two WRACKS units from your army, or one other DRUKHARI unit from your army.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in each of those units have the [LETHAL HITS] ability.
Dark Harvest.flavour: Wicked sickles and serrated blades hack through writhing flesh as the Drukhari harvest agony and suffering.

Eager for the Kill.name: EAGER FOR THE KILL
Eager for the Kill.target: Up to two WYCHES units from your army, or one other DRUKHARI unit from your army, that have not been selected to move this phase.
Eager for the Kill.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time one of those units Advances, do not make an Advance roll for it. Instead, until the end of the phase, add 6" to the Move characteristic of models in that unit (this is not cumulative with the REAVERS’ Matchless Swiftness ability).
Eager for the Kill.text:
WHEN: Start of your Movement phase.

TARGET: Up to two WYCHES units from your army, or one other DRUKHARI unit from your army, that have not been selected to move this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time one of those units Advances, do not make an Advance roll for it. Instead, until the end of the phase, add 6" to the Move characteristic of models in that unit (this is not cumulative with the REAVERS’ Matchless Swiftness ability).
Eager for the Kill.flavour: The exhilarating promise of bloodshed goads these warriors into battle with preternatural haste.

Raid and Fade.name: RAID AND FADE
Raid and Fade.target: Up to two KABALITE WARRIORS units from your army, or one other DRUKHARI unit from your army (excluding SCOURGES and AIRCRAFT).
Raid and Fade.effect: Each of those units can make a Normal move of up to 6".
Raid and Fade.restrictions: You cannot select units that are within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units. Until the end of the turn, those units are not eligible to declare a charge.
Raid and Fade.text:
WHEN: End of your Shooting phase.

TARGET: Up to two KABALITE WARRIORS units from your army, or one other DRUKHARI unit from your army (excluding SCOURGES and AIRCRAFT).

EFFECT: Each of those units can make a Normal move of up to 6".

RESTRICTIONS: You cannot select units that are within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units. Until the end of the turn, those units are not eligible to declare a charge.
Raid and Fade.flavour: The Drukhari are masters at using hit-and-run tactics, engaging a target with a flurry of shots before quickly manoeuvring into cover or out of sight.

enhancements.name: - Dark Vitality
enhancements.text: **^^Drukhari^^** model only. The bearer's unit is always Empowered - you do not need to spend any Pain tokens to activate that unit's Pain abilities

enhancements.name: - Labyrinthine Cunning
enhancements.text:
**^^Archon^^** model only. At the start of your Command phase, if the bearer is on the battlefield, you can do one of the following:
Spend 1 Pain token and gain 1CP.
Roll one D6: on a 4+, you gain 1CP.

enhancements.name: - Eye of Spite
enhancements.text: **^^Succubus^^** model only. Improve the Attacks and Armour Penetration characteristics of the bearer’s melee weapons by 1. Each time the bearer's unit is selected to fight, you can spend 1 Pain token; if you do, until the end of the phase, improve the Attacks and Armour Penetration characteristics of the bearer’s melee weapons by 2 instead.

enhancements.name: - Crucible of Malediction
enhancements.text: **^^Haemonculus^^** model only. Once per battle, in your Shooting phase, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, you can spend 1 Pain token. Then, each enemy unit within 12" of the bearer must take a Battle-shock test, subtracting 1 from that test if you spent 1 Pain token. Each time a **^^Psyker^^** unit fails that test, it suffers 3 mortal wounds.

rule.name: Rain of Cruelty
rule.text:
Each time a ^^**Drukhari**^^ unit from your army disembarks from a ^^**Transport**^^, until the end of the turn:
Ranged weapons equipped by models in that disembarking units have the ^^**[Ignores Cover]**^^ ability.
Melee weapons equipped by models in that disembarking unit have the ^^**[Lance]**^^ ability.

Vicious Blades.name: VICIOUS BLADES
Vicious Blades.when: Fight phase, just after a DRUKHARI TRANSPORT from your army has selected its targets.
Vicious Blades.effect: After your TRANSPORT has fought, select one enemy unit that was the target of one or more of those attacks and roll one D6 for each model embarked within your TRANSPORT, adding 1 to the result if that embarked model is a WRACKS model: for each 5+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound (to a maximum of 6 mortal wounds).
Vicious Blades.text:
WHEN: Fight phase, just after a DRUKHARI TRANSPORT from your army has selected its targets.

TARGET: That TRANSPORT.

EFFECT: After your TRANSPORT has fought, select one enemy unit that was the target of one or more of those attacks and roll one D6 for each model embarked within your TRANSPORT, adding 1 to the result if that embarked model is a WRACKS model: for each 5+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound (to a maximum of 6 mortal wounds).
Vicious Blades.flavour: Wielding a horrifying array of hooked boarding blades, barbed lariats and other specialised tools of agony, these warriors hack and slash at their foes even as their transport skims low overhead.

Wraithlike Retreat.name: WRAITHLIKE RETREAT
Wraithlike Retreat.target: One DRUKHARI INFANTRY unit from your army that fought this phase.
Wraithlike Retreat.effect: Your unit can make a Normal or Fall Back move, but unless it is a WYCHES unit, it must end that move wholly within 3" horizontally and 5" vertically of a friendly DRUKHARI TRANSPORT and must embark within that TRANSPORT at the end of that move (otherwise, it cannot make that move). Your unit can embark within that TRANSPORT in a turn it disembarked from that TRANSPORT.
Wraithlike Retreat.text:
WHEN: End of the Fight phase.

TARGET: One DRUKHARI INFANTRY unit from your army that fought this phase.

EFFECT: Your unit can make a Normal or Fall Back move, but unless it is a WYCHES unit, it must end that move wholly within 3" horizontally and 5" vertically of a friendly DRUKHARI TRANSPORT and must embark within that TRANSPORT at the end of that move (otherwise, it cannot make that move). Your unit can embark within that TRANSPORT in a turn it disembarked from that TRANSPORT.
Wraithlike Retreat.flavour: Employing smoke grenades, paralysing mists or simple cunning and agility, these warriors slip away like spectres.

Pounce on the Prey.name: POUNCE ON THE PREY
Pounce on the Prey.when: Your Movement phase, just after a DRUKHARI INFANTRY unit from your army disembarks from a TRANSPORT that made a Normal move this phase.
Pounce on the Prey.effect: Your unit makes an assault disembark move (Core Rules, 18.06) for that disembarkation.
Pounce on the Prey.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase, just after a DRUKHARI INFANTRY unit from your army disembarks from a TRANSPORT that made a Normal move this phase.

TARGET: That INFANTRY unit.

EFFECT: Your unit makes an assault disembark move (Core Rules, 18.06) for that disembarkation.
Pounce on the Prey.flavour: Incredible alien agility and a delight in taking wild risks help these warriors to leap acrobatically from their skimming transports directly into battle.

Skyborne Annihilation.name: SKYBORNE ANNIHILATION
Skyborne Annihilation.target: One DRUKHARI unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase and that disembarked from a TRANSPORT this turn.
Skyborne Annihilation.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability, or the [SUSTAINED HITS 2] ability if your unit is a KABALITE WARRIORS or HAND OF THE ARCHON unit.
Skyborne Annihilation.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase.

TARGET: One DRUKHARI unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase and that disembarked from a TRANSPORT this turn.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability, or the [SUSTAINED HITS 2] ability if your unit is a KABALITE WARRIORS or HAND OF THE ARCHON unit.
Skyborne Annihilation.flavour: These warriors are well versed in raining suppressing fire on the foe even as they close with them from on high, shredding defences and leaving the survivors easy prey for the raid.

Swooping Mockery.name: SWOOPING MOCKERY
Swooping Mockery.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
Swooping Mockery.target: One DRUKHARI TRANSPORT from your army that is within 8" of that enemy unit.
Swooping Mockery.effect: Your TRANSPORT can make a Normal move of up to 6".
Swooping Mockery.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.

TARGET: One DRUKHARI TRANSPORT from your army that is within 8" of that enemy unit.

EFFECT: Your TRANSPORT can make a Normal move of up to 6".
Swooping Mockery.flavour: The crew of this skimmer delight in evading and taunting their enemies with mocking ease.

Night Shield.name: NIGHT SHIELD
Night Shield.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Night Shield.target: One DRUKHARI VEHICLE unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Night Shield.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have a 4+ invulnerable save.
Night Shield.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One DRUKHARI VEHICLE unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have a 4+ invulnerable save.
Night Shield.flavour: These powerful Drukhari devices occlude their raiding vehicles from physical sight, targeting sensors, and even psychic senses.

rule.name: Combat Drugs
rule.text:
At the start of your Command phase, select which Combat Drugs will be active for your army until the start of your next Command phase. To do so, either select one from the list below (you cannot select the same Combat Drug more than once per battle), or randomly select two by rolling two D6. When doing so randomly, Combat Drugs you have previously selected can become active again, but if you randomly select one that is already active for your army, it has no additional effect.


**1. Adrenalight**
Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons equipped by ^^**Wych Cult**^^ models from your army.


**2. Hypex**
Add 2" to the Move characteristic of ^^**Wych Cult**^^ models from your army.


**3. Serpentin**
Improve the Weapon Skill characteristic of melee weapons equipped by ^^**Wych Cult**^^ models from your army by 1.


**4. Painbringer**
Add 1 to the Toughness characteristic of ^^**Wych CUlt**^^ models from your army.


**5. Grave Lotus**
Add 1 to the Strength characteristic of melee weapons equipped by ^^**Wych Cult**^^ models from your army.


**6. Splintermind**
Improve the Leadership characteristic of ^^**Wych Cult**^^ models from your army by 1, and improve the Ballistic Skill characteristic of ranged weapons equipped by ^^**Wych Cult**^^ models from your army by 1.

Berserk Fugue.name: BERSERK FUGUE
Berserk Fugue.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Berserk Fugue.target: One WYCH CULT unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Berserk Fugue.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, do not remove it from play. The destroyed model can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.
Berserk Fugue.text:
WHEN: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One WYCH CULT unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, do not remove it from play. The destroyed model can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.
Berserk Fugue.flavour: The cult's gladiators enter a killing trance when combat is joined, allowing them to fight on through the most grievous hurts with undimmed ferocity.

Deadly Debut.name: DEADLY DEBUT
Deadly Debut.target: One DRUKHARI unit from your army that made a Charge move this turn and has not been selected to fight this phase.
Deadly Debut.effect: Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [LETHAL HITS] ability. If your unit is a WYCHES unit, until the end of the phase, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in your unit by 1 as well.

TARGET: One DRUKHARI unit from your army that made a Charge move this turn and has not been selected to fight this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [LETHAL HITS] ability. If your unit is a WYCHES unit, until the end of the phase, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in your unit by 1 as well.
Deadly Debut.flavour: Imitating Lelith Hesperax, these warriors begin their gladiatorial bout with an opening so spectacularly violent that none can fail to be impressed.

Feigned Weakness.name: FEIGNED WEAKNESS
Feigned Weakness.when: Your Movement phase, just after a DRUKHARI unit from your army Falls Back.
Feigned Weakness.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in turn in which it Fell Back.
Feigned Weakness.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase, just after a DRUKHARI unit from your army Falls Back.

TARGET: That DRUKHARI unit.

EFFECT: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in turn in which it Fell Back.
Feigned Weakness.flavour: Employing a common ruse from the arenas, the Drukhari appear to cower, wounded and exhausted, before surging back at their overconfident opponents with blades and fangs bared.

Preternatural Agility.name: PRETERNATURAL AGILITY
Preternatural Agility.when: Start of your Movement or Charge phase.
Preternatural Agility.target: One WYCH CULT unit from your army.
Preternatural Agility.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit makes a Normal, Advance or Charge move, you can ignore any or all modifiers to its Move characteristic and to Advance and Charge rolls made for it and, until the end of the turn, each time a model in your unit makes such a move, it can move horizontally through models (when doing so, such a model can move within Engagement Range of such models but cannot end a Normal or Advance move within Engagement Range of them).
Preternatural Agility.text:
WHEN: Start of your Movement or Charge phase.

TARGET: One WYCH CULT unit from your army.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit makes a Normal, Advance or Charge move, you can ignore any or all modifiers to its Move characteristic and to Advance and Charge rolls made for it and, until the end of the turn, each time a model in your unit makes such a move, it can move horizontally through models (when doing so, such a model can move within Engagement Range of such models but cannot end a Normal or Advance move within Engagement Range of them).
Preternatural Agility.flavour: Bounding and weaving, the Wyches cross the battlefield with unmatched acrobatic agility.

A Challenge Met.name: A CHALLENGE MET
A Challenge Met.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a fall-back move.
A Challenge Met.target: One friendly unengaged WYCH CULT unit that is within 6" of that enemy unit.
A Challenge Met.effect: Declare a charge with your unit. When selecting charge targets, you can only select enemy units that made a fall-back move this phase and are within the maximum distance.
A Challenge Met.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a fall-back move.

TARGET: One friendly unengaged WYCH CULT unit that is within 6" of that enemy unit.

EFFECT: Declare a charge with your unit. When selecting charge targets, you can only select enemy units that made a fall-back move this phase and are within the maximum distance.
A Challenge Met.flavour: The foe's advance is not something to be wary of but rather an opportunity to be seized.

Acrobatic Display.name: ACROBATIC DISPLAY
Acrobatic Display.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Acrobatic Display.target: One WYCH CULT unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Acrobatic Display.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have a 5+ invulnerable save.
Acrobatic Display.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One WYCH CULT unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have a 5+ invulnerable save.
Acrobatic Display.flavour: Moving so quickly they seem to blur, the Wyches evade incoming fire with contemptuous elegance.

enhancements.name: - Pharmacophex
enhancements.text: ^^**Succubus**^^ model only. At the start of your Command phase, after selecting which Combat Drugs will be active for your army, roll one D6 and consult the Combat Drugs list. The result rolled applies to the bearer's unit until the start of your next Command phase in addition to any other Combat Drugs that are active for your army. If you randomly select one that is already active for your army, it has no additional effect.

enhancements.name: - Chronoshard
enhancements.text: ^^** Succubus**^^ model only. Once per battle, at the start of the Fight phase, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, until the end of the phase, models in the bearer's unit have the Fights First ability.

enhancements.name: - Periapt of Torments
enhancements.text: ^^**Succubus**^^ model only. Enemy units cannot use the Fire Overwatch stratagem to shoot at the bearer's unit.

enhancements.name: - Morghenna’s Curse
enhancements.text: ^^**Succubus**^^ model only. Improve the Armour Penetration and Damage characteristics of the bearer's melee weapons by 1.

rule.name: Stitchflesh Abominations
rule.text: Each time an attack targets a **^^Haemonculus Covens^^** unit from your army, if the Strength characteristic of that attack is greater than the Toughness characteristic of your unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.

Postmortality.name: POSTMORTALITY
Postmortality.target: One HAEMONCULUS model from your army that was just destroyed. You can use this Stratagem on that model even though it was just destroyed.
Postmortality.effect: Spend 1-3 Pain tokens. At the end of the phase, set up the destroyed model on the battlefield, unengaged and as close as possible to where it was destroyed. That model is not part of an attached unit and its unit has a starting strength of 1. That model has a number of wounds remaining equal to the number of Pain tokens you just spent.
Postmortality.restrictions: You cannot use this Stratagem if you have 0 Pain tokens, and you cannot target the same HAEMONCULUS model with this Stratagem more than once per battle.
Postmortality.text:
WHEN: Any phase.

TARGET: One HAEMONCULUS model from your army that was just destroyed. You can use this Stratagem on that model even though it was just destroyed.

EFFECT: Spend 1-3 Pain tokens. At the end of the phase, set up the destroyed model on the battlefield, unengaged and as close as possible to where it was destroyed. That model is not part of an attached unit and its unit has a starting strength of 1. That model has a number of wounds remaining equal to the number of Pain tokens you just spent.

RESTRICTION: You cannot use this Stratagem if you have 0 Pain tokens, and you cannot target the same HAEMONCULUS model with this Stratagem more than once per battle.
Postmortality.flavour: To the greatest Haemonculi, death is but an intriguing and temporary state to be experienced.

Symphony of Suffering.name: SYMPHONY OF SUFFERING
Symphony of Suffering.when: Fight phase, just after a DRUKHARI unit from your army destroys an enemy unit.
Symphony of Suffering.effect: Each enemy unit within 9" of and visible to your unit must take a Battle-shock test, subtracting 1 from that test if your unit is a HAEMONCULUS COVENS unit.
Symphony of Suffering.text:
WHEN: Fight phase, just after a DRUKHARI unit from your army destroys an enemy unit.

TARGET: That DRUKHARI unit.

EFFECT: Each enemy unit within 9" of and visible to your unit must take a Battle-shock test, subtracting 1 from that test if your unit is a HAEMONCULUS COVENS unit.
Symphony of Suffering.flavour: So extreme are the foe's agonies that they spread a shock wave of terror through their comrades.

Poisoner’s Art.name: POISONER’S ART
Poisoner’s Art.when: Fight phase, just after a HAEMONCULUS COVENS unit from your army has fought.
Poisoner’s Art.effect: Select one enemy unit (excluding VEHICLES) hit by one or more of your unit’s attacks this phase. Until the end of the battle, that enemy unit is poisoned. At the start of each Command phase, roll one D6 for each poisoned unit on the battlefield: on a 4+, that unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.
Poisoner’s Art.text:
WHEN: Fight phase, just after a HAEMONCULUS COVENS unit from your army has fought.

TARGET: That HAEMONCULUS COVENS unit.

EFFECT: Select one enemy unit (excluding VEHICLES) hit by one or more of your unit’s attacks this phase. Until the end of the battle, that enemy unit is poisoned. At the start of each Command phase, roll one D6 for each poisoned unit on the battlefield: on a 4+, that unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.
Poisoner’s Art.flavour: The venoms wielded by these warriors are potent enough to impress Shaimesh himself.

Distillers of Fear.name: DISTILLERS OF FEAR
Distillers of Fear.target: One HAEMONCULUS COVENS unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
Distillers of Fear.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets an enemy unit that is Battle-shocked, that attack has the [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] ability.
Distillers of Fear.text:
WHEN: Fight phase.

TARGET: One HAEMONCULUS COVENS unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets an enemy unit that is Battle-shocked, that attack has the [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] ability.
Distillers of Fear.flavour: By arcane syringe and unholy invocation, the enemy's terror is syphoned out of their bodies, leaving them as little more than contorted husks.

Connoisseurs of Pain.name: CONNOISSEURS OF PAIN
Connoisseurs of Pain.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Connoisseurs of Pain.target: One DRUKHARI unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Connoisseurs of Pain.effect: Spend 1 Pain token. Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1. At the end of the phase, if your unit is still on the battlefield and it is a HAEMONCULUS COVENS unit, you gain 1 Pain token.
Connoisseurs of Pain.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One DRUKHARI unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Spend 1 Pain token. Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1. At the end of the phase, if your unit is still on the battlefield and it is a HAEMONCULUS COVENS unit, you gain 1 Pain token.
Connoisseurs of Pain.flavour: These epicureans of extreme sensation revel in their agonies as much as those of the foe.

Enfolding Nightmare.name: ENFOLDING NIGHTMARE
Enfolding Nightmare.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot.
Enfolding Nightmare.target: One HAEMONCULUS COVENS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Enfolding Nightmare.effect: Your unit can make a surge move of up to D6".
Enfolding Nightmare.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot.

TARGET: One HAEMONCULUS COVENS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Your unit can make a surge move of up to D6".
Enfolding Nightmare.flavour: Even as the prey seek to drive the covenites back with hails of firepower, the horrors lurch closer.

enhancements.name: - Master Regenesist
enhancements.text: ^^**Haemonculus**^^ model only. Each time the bearer uses its Fleshcraft ability, you can return up to D3+3 destroyed Bodyguard models to the bearer's unit instead of D3+1.

enhancements.name: - Master Nemesine
enhancements.text: ^^**Haemonculus**^^ model only. The bearer's weapons have the ^^**[Anti-Beast 2+]**^^ and ^^**[Anti-Monster 4+]**^^ abilities.

enhancements.name: - Master Artisan
enhancements.text: ^^**Haemonculus**^^ model only. Add 1 to the bearer's Wounds characteristic and add 1 to the Toughness characteristic of models in the bearer's unit.

enhancements.name: - Master Repugnomancer (Aura)
enhancements.text: ^^**Haemonculus**^^ model only. Add 3" to the range of the bearer's Fear Incarnate ability, and each time a friendly ^^**Drukhari**^^ within 9" of the bearer fails a Battle-shock test or is destroyed, roll one D6; on a 4+, you gain 1 Pain token.

rule.name: Murderous Agenda
rule.text:
At the start of the first battle round, select one of the Contracts from below, then select one unit from your opponent's army that matches the 'Contract' description in the Contract. Until that Contract is completed, that unit is your Contract unit and ^^**Kabal**^^ and ^^**Blades For Hire**^^ units from your army have the ability stated in that Contract. At the start of your Command phase, if your Contract unit is destroyed, that Contract is completed and you gain 3 Pain tokens.

**Trophy Hunters**
**Contract:** One ^^**Character**^^ unit.
**Ability:** Each time a ^^**Kabal**^^ or ^^**Blades for Hire**^^ model in this unit makes an attack that targets the Contract unit, that attack has the ^^**[Precision]**^^ ability.

**Sow Fear and Terror**
**Contract:** One ^^**Infantry**^^ or ^^**Mounted**^^ unit (excluding units containing only ^^**Character**^^ models). At the start of Your Command phase, this Contract is completed if all non-^^**Character**^^ models in that unit are destroyed.
**Ability:** Each time a ^^**Kabal**^^ or ^^**Blades for Hire**^^ model in this unit makes an attack that targets an ^^**Infantry**^^ or ^^**Mounted**^^ unit, that attack has the ^^**[Sustained Hits 1]**^^ ability.

**Show of Strength**
**Contract:** One ^^**Monster**^^ or ^^**Vehicle**^^ unit.
**Ability:** Each time a ^^**Kabal**^^ or ^^**Blades for Hire**^^ model in this unit makes an attack that targets a ^^**Monster**^^ or ^^**Vehicle**^^ unit, that attack has the ^^**[Lethal Hits]**^^ ability.

Double-cross.name: DOUBLE-CROSS
Double-cross.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Double-cross.target: One KABAL or BLADES FOR HIRE unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks, and one friendly DRUKHARI unit (excluding VEHICLES).
Double-cross.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time you would allocate an attack to a model in your KABAL or BLADES FOR HIRE unit, if your DRUKHARI unit is within Engagement Range of the attacking model, no saving throw is made for that attack; instead, your DRUKHARI unit suffers a number of mortal wounds equal to the Damage characteristic of that attack.
Double-cross.text:
WHEN: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One KABAL or BLADES FOR HIRE unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks, and one friendly DRUKHARI unit (excluding VEHICLES).

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time you would allocate an attack to a model in your KABAL or BLADES FOR HIRE unit, if your DRUKHARI unit is within Engagement Range of the attacking model, no saving throw is made for that attack; instead, your DRUKHARI unit suffers a number of mortal wounds equal to the Damage characteristic of that attack.
Double-cross.flavour: What better way to eliminate rivals than tricking them into taking the blade meant for your ribs?

Taken Alive.name: TAKEN ALIVE
Taken Alive.target: One DRUKHARI unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
Taken Alive.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, add 1 to the Hit roll. If your Contract unit is destroyed as a result of those attacks, every unit in your opponent’s army must take a Battle-shock test. You cannot gain more than 3 Pain tokens as a result of failed Battle-shock tests caused by this Stratagem.
Taken Alive.text:
WHEN: Fight phase.

TARGET: One DRUKHARI unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, add 1 to the Hit roll. If your Contract unit is destroyed as a result of those attacks, every unit in your opponent’s army must take a Battle-shock test. You cannot gain more than 3 Pain tokens as a result of failed Battle-shock tests caused by this Stratagem.
Taken Alive.flavour: Borne away screaming into the shadows, everyone knows these unfortunates face a dreadful fate.

Tailored Toxins.name: TAILORED TOXINS
Tailored Toxins.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
Tailored Toxins.target: One KABAL or BLADES FOR HIRE unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
Tailored Toxins.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets your Contract unit, an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.
Tailored Toxins.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.

TARGET: One KABAL or BLADES FOR HIRE unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets your Contract unit, an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.
Tailored Toxins.flavour: Specially prepared for their chosen prey, these malignant poisons are the anathema of their targets.

Enemies Without Number.name: ENEMIES WITHOUT NUMBER
Enemies Without Number.when: Your Command phase, just after you complete a Contract.
Enemies Without Number.target: One ARCHON WARLORD from your army.
Enemies Without Number.effect: Select one new Contract (this can be one you have already completed), then select one unit from your opponent’s army that is on the battlefield and matches the ‘Contract’ description in that Contract. Until that Contract is completed, that unit is your Contract unit and the Murderous Agenda Detachment rule applies as normal.
Enemies Without Number.text:
WHEN: Your Command phase, just after you complete a Contract.

TARGET: One ARCHON WARLORD from your army.

EFFECT: Select one new Contract (this can be one you have already completed), then select one unit from your opponent’s army that is on the battlefield and matches the ‘Contract’ description in that Contract. Until that Contract is completed, that unit is your Contract unit and the Murderous Agenda Detachment rule applies as normal.
Enemies Without Number.flavour: This Archon’s personal kill list of rivals, nemeses and victims is virtually never-ending.

Making a Point.name: MAKING A POINT
Making a Point.target: One KABALITE WARRIORS or HAND OF THE ARCHON unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Making a Point.effect: Until the end of the phase, improve the Ballistic Skill and Armour Penetration characteristics of ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit by 1.
Making a Point.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase.

TARGET: One KABALITE WARRIORS or HAND OF THE ARCHON unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, improve the Ballistic Skill and Armour Penetration characteristics of ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit by 1.
Making a Point.flavour: Whether seeking to impress a watching Archon, show up rivals or revel in their supremacy, these marksmen fire for spiteful effect.

Deadly Deceivers.name: DEADLY DECEIVERS
Deadly Deceivers.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Deadly Deceivers.target: One KABAL or BLADES FOR HIRE unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Deadly Deceivers.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit can only be selected as the target of a ranged attack if the attacking model is within 18".
Deadly Deceivers.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One KABAL or BLADES FOR HIRE unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, your unit can only be selected as the target of a ranged attack if the attacking model is within 18".
Deadly Deceivers.flavour: A life lived amidst the shadowed spires of Commorragh teaches many ways to creep up on your enemies, unseen and unsuspected.

enhancements.name: - Leechbite Plate
enhancements.text: ^^**Archon**^^ model only. The bearer has a Save characteristic of 3+. At the start of either player's Command phase, you can spend 1 Pain token; if you do, the bearer regains all of its lost wounds.

enhancements.name: - Webway Awl
enhancements.text: ^^**Archon**^^ model only. Models in the bearer's unit have the Deep Strike ability, and you can target the bearer's unit with the Rapid Ingress Stratagem for 0CP.

enhancements.name: - Informant Network
enhancements.text: ^^**Archon**^^ model only. At the start of the Declare Battle Formations step, select up to three ^^**Kabalite Warriors**^^ and/or ^^**Hand of the Archon**^^ units from your army; those units gain the Infiltrators ability.

enhancements.name: - Towering Arrogance
enhancements.text: ^^**Archon**^^ models only. While the bearer is leading a unit, improve the Leadership and Objective Control characteristics of models in that unit by 1.

rule.name: Contracted Harvest
rule.text:
Friendly **BLADES FOR HIRE/KABAL** units’ ranged attacks have **[SUSTAINED HITS 1: non-MONSTER/VEHICLE]**.

This **detachment** has the **KABAL** tag and cannot be taken with another **KABAL detachment**.

Prioritised Victim.name: PRIORITISED VICTIM
Prioritised Victim.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly BLADES FOR HIRE/KABAL unit targets a CHARACTER unit.
Prioritised Victim.effect:
Your unit’s attacks that target a CHARACTER unit can:

- Re-roll hit rolls of 1.

- Re-roll wound rolls of 1.
Prioritised Victim.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly BLADES FOR HIRE/KABAL unit targets a CHARACTER unit.

TARGET: That BLADES FOR HIRE/KABAL unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s attacks that target a CHARACTER unit can:

- Re-roll hit rolls of 1.

- Re-roll wound rolls of 1.
Prioritised Victim.flavour: Contracts to annihilate, maim or capture singular victims of rarefied value are eagerly competed for by a kabal’s killers.

Shadows’ Reach.name: SHADOWS’ REACH
Shadows’ Reach.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly BLADES FOR HIRE/KABAL unit has shot.
Shadows’ Reach.effect: Those attacks do not prevent your unit from being hidden.
Shadows’ Reach.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly BLADES FOR HIRE/KABAL unit has shot.

TARGET: That BLADES FOR HIRE/KABAL unit.

EFFECT: Those attacks do not prevent your unit from being hidden.
Shadows’ Reach.flavour: The capability of militant kabals to project their killing power is rightfully feared, as is the fact that the perpetrators can usually never be found.

Killers from the Dark Spires.name: KILLERS FROM THE DARK SPIRES
Killers from the Dark Spires.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly KABALITE WARRIORS unit is selected to shoot.
Killers from the Dark Spires.effect: Your unit’s ranged attacks have [IGNORES COVER].
Killers from the Dark Spires.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly KABALITE WARRIORS unit is selected to shoot.

TARGET: That KABALITE WARRIORS unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s ranged attacks have [IGNORES COVER].
Killers from the Dark Spires.flavour: Defensive barriers or camouflage are little protection against those who have honed their talents hunting amongst the twisted and dark spires of their kabal’s territory.

enhancements.name: - Towering Arrogance
enhancements.text: ^^**Archon**^^ models only. While the bearer is leading a unit, improve the Leadership and Objective Control characteristics of models in that unit by 1.

enhancements.name: - Contempt for Rivals
enhancements.text: **ARCHON** model only. This unit’s attacks have **[PRECISION]**.

rule.name: Exacting Cruelty
rule.text:
Friendly **WYCH CULT** units' melee attacks have **[LETHAL HITS: non-MONSTER/VEHICLE]**.

This **detachment** has the **WYCH CULT** tag and cannot be taken with another **WYCH CULT detachment**.

Planned Strikes.name: PLANNED STRIKES
Planned Strikes.when: Fight phase, when a friendly WYCH CULT unit is selected to fight.
Planned Strikes.effect: Your unit’s melee attacks have [LETHAL HITS].
Planned Strikes.text:
WHEN: Fight phase, when a friendly WYCH CULT unit is selected to fight.

TARGET: That WYCH CULT unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s melee attacks have [LETHAL HITS].
Planned Strikes.flavour: Murderous rehearsals ensure that those who survive can bring down the most resilient of prey in puissant displays.

Sculpting the Stage.name: SCULPTING THE STAGE
Sculpting the Stage.when: Your Movement phase, when a friendly WYCH CULT unit is selected to make an advance/fall-back move.
Sculpting the Stage.effect: That move does not prevent your unit from being eligible to start an action.
Sculpting the Stage.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase, when a friendly WYCH CULT unit is selected to make an advance/fall-back move.

TARGET: That WYCH CULT unit.

EFFECT: That move does not prevent your unit from being eligible to start an action.
Sculpting the Stage.flavour: Gauche are the gladiators who kill too relentlessly. Preparing the stage with a variety of torments in order to build the tension for a delightful crescendo is the mark of a true artist.

Acrobatic Display.name: ACROBATIC DISPLAY
Acrobatic Display.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly WYCH CULT unit.
Acrobatic Display.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly WYCH CULT unit.

TARGET: That WYCH CULT unit.

EFFECT: Your unit has 5+ InSv.
Acrobatic Display.flavour: Moving so quickly they seem to blur, the Wyches evade incoming fire with contemptuous elegance.

enhancements.name: - Periapt of Torments
enhancements.text: ^^**Succubus**^^ model only. Enemy units cannot use the Fire Overwatch stratagem to shoot at the bearer's unit.

enhancements.name: - Hyperstimm Trafficker
enhancements.text: **SUCCUBUS** model only. This unit has +1 **T**.

rule.name: Darkest Artifice
rule.text:
Attacks that target friendly **CRONOS/TALOS** units with a **S** greater than that unit’s **T** have ‑1 to **wound rolls**.


This **detachment** has the **COVENS** tag and cannot be taken with another **COVENS detachment**.

Salting the Wound.name: SALTING THE WOUND
Salting the Wound.when: Fight phase, when a friendly CRONOS/TALOS unit is selected to fight.
Salting the Wound.effect: Your unit’s attacks that target a battle-shocked unit have [DEVASTATING WOUNDS].
Salting the Wound.text:
WHEN: Fight phase, when a friendly CRONOS/TALOS unit is selected to fight.

TARGET: That CRONOS/TALOS unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s attacks that target a battle-shocked unit have [DEVASTATING WOUNDS].
Salting the Wound.flavour: Confusion, terror, and panic are triggers for a Haemonculus’ Engines of Pain, which stimulate them to drive their evil augmentations even deeper into the foe.

Dividends of Agony.name: DIVIDENDS OF AGONY
Dividends of Agony.when: Fight phase, when a friendly HAEMONCULUS COVENS unit destroys an enemy unit.
Dividends of Agony.effect: Select one visible enemy unit within 12" of your unit. That enemy unit makes a battle-shock roll, with -1 to that battle-shock roll.
Dividends of Agony.text:
WHEN: Fight phase, when a friendly HAEMONCULUS COVENS unit destroys an enemy unit.

TARGET: That HAEMONCULUS COVENS unit.

EFFECT: Select one visible enemy unit within 12" of your unit. That enemy unit makes a battle-shock roll, with -1 to that battle-shock roll.
Dividends of Agony.flavour: Sharing is typically anathema to the self‑centred Drukhari, except where horror can be fruitfully reinvested in those marked for later harvest.

Urgent Metamorphosis.name: URGENT METAMORPHOSIS
Urgent Metamorphosis.when: Your Movement phase, when a friendly HAEMONCULUS COVENS unit is selected to make a fall-back move.
Urgent Metamorphosis.effect: That move does not prevent your unit from being eligible to declare a charge.
Urgent Metamorphosis.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase, when a friendly HAEMONCULUS COVENS unit is selected to make a fall-back move.

TARGET: That HAEMONCULUS COVENS unit.

EFFECT: That move does not prevent your unit from being eligible to declare a charge.
Urgent Metamorphosis.flavour: The unhurried menace exuded by Covenites as they extricate themselves from gore‑slick foes can metamorphose in an instant back to pain‑hungry savagery.

enhancements.name: - Gnarlskin Experimentor
enhancements.text: **HAEMONCULUS** model only. Attacks that target this unit with a **S** greater than your unit’s **T** have ‑1 to **wound rolls**.

enhancements.name: - Elixir of the Corpse CourtsUPGRADE
enhancements.text: CRONOS/TALOS unit only. This unit has 5+ InSv.

rule.name: Feast of Pain
rule.text:
Units from your army with the Power From Pain ability retain that ability and gain this one.

At the start of the battle, you gain 1 Pain token.

rule.name: Commorrite Rivalries
rule.text: Each time a DRUKHARI CHARACTER model from your army destroys an enemy CHARACTER unit, you gain 1 Pain token. In addition, each time you use the Battlefield Command Stratagem, you can expend 1 Pain token from your Pain token pool. If you do, decrease that Stratagems cost by 1CP for that usage.

Shipboard Shades.name: SHIPBOARD SHADES
Shipboard Shades.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Shipboard Shades.target: One DRUKHARI unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Shipboard Shades.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.
Shipboard Shades.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One DRUKHARI unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.
Shipboard Shades.flavour: Amidst the strobing lumens and gouting steam of voidship combat, the Drukhari flicker and flit like malevolent, half-seen shadows.

Crew-thieves.name: CREW-THIEVES
Crew-thieves.target: One WRACKS unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
Crew-thieves.effect: Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [ANTI-INFANTRY 3+] ability.
Crew-thieves.text:
WHEN: Fight phase.

TARGET: One WRACKS unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [ANTI-INFANTRY 3+] ability.
Crew-thieves.flavour: The fast-acting incapacitation toxins on the blades of these Wracks allow them to lay low the defenders, before dragging them away, alive but powerless, to a far more horrible fate than death.

Voidship Gladiators.name: VOIDSHIP GLADIATORS
Voidship Gladiators.target: One WYCHES unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.
Voidship Gladiators.effect: Roll one D6: on a 2+, until the end of the turn, enemy units cannot fire Overwatch at your unit.
Voidship Gladiators.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase.

TARGET: One WYCHES unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.

EFFECT: Roll one D6: on a 2+, until the end of the turn, enemy units cannot fire Overwatch at your unit.
Voidship Gladiators.flavour: Treating the vessel they have boarded as just another arena to perform in, these Wyches turn every iota of their skill and agility to the task.

Veteran Pirates.name: VETERAN PIRATES
Veteran Pirates.when: Your Shooting phase, just after a KABALITE WARRIORS unit from your army has shot.
Veteran Pirates.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 3".
Veteran Pirates.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, just after a KABALITE WARRIORS unit from your army has shot.

TARGET: That KABALITE WARRIORS unit.

EFFECT: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 3".
Veteran Pirates.flavour: No strangers to shipboard warfare, these warriors are skilled in loosing volleys then vanishing swiftly back behind corners and bulkheads to avoid reprisals.

enhancements.name: Power and Greed
enhancements.text: The first time in each turn that the bearer is Empowered, roll one D6: on a 3+, you gain 1 Pain token.

enhancements.name: Spiteful Demise
enhancements.text: When the bearer is destroyed, if it has not fought this phase, roll one D6: on a 2+, do not remove it from play. The bearer can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.

rule.name: Feast of Pain
rule.text:
Units from your army with the Power From Pain ability retain that ability and gain this one.

At the start of the battle, you gain 1 Pain token.

rule.name: Raid and Pillage
rule.text: Each time a DRUKHARI unit from your army destroys an enemy unit, if that enemy unit was within range of an objective marker controlled by your opponent at the start of the phase, you gain 1 Pain token. In addition, in your Command phase, you can select one objective marker you control that has one or more KABAL units from your army within range of it, then expend 1 Pain token from your Pain token pool. If you do, that objective marker is Secured by your army.

Elusive Duellists.name: ELUSIVE DUELLISTS
Elusive Duellists.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Elusive Duellists.target: One DRUKHARI unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Elusive Duellists.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll and, if your unit has the INCUBI keyword, models in your unit have a 4+ invulnerable save.
Elusive Duellists.text:
WHEN: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One DRUKHARI unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll and, if your unit has the INCUBI keyword, models in your unit have a 4+ invulnerable save.
Elusive Duellists.flavour: These warriors delight in the close-quarters blade-duels of boarding actions, weaving around their enemies' blows and cutting them down in droves.

Deckplate Sweepers.name: DECKPLATE SWEEPERS
Deckplate Sweepers.target: One KABAL unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Deckplate Sweepers.effect: Until the end of the phase, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of splinter cannons, splinter rifles and splinter pistols equipped by models in your unit by 1.
Deckplate Sweepers.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase.

TARGET: One KABAL unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of splinter cannons, splinter rifles and splinter pistols equipped by models in your unit by 1.
Deckplate Sweepers.flavour: Indiscriminate hails of splinter fire fill chambers and corridors, leaving nowhere to hide in the enclosed space.

Take Them Alive.name: TAKE THEM ALIVE
Take Them Alive.when: Your Shooting phase, just after a KABAL unit from your army has shot.
Take Them Alive.effect: Select one enemy unit hit by one or more of your unit’s attacks this phase (excluding those made with Pistols). That enemy unit must take a Battle-shock test, subtracting 1 from the result if your unit is within 6” of it.
Take Them Alive.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, just after a KABAL unit from your army has shot.

TARGET: That KABAL unit.

EFFECT: Select one enemy unit hit by one or more of your unit’s attacks this phase (excluding those made with Pistols). That enemy unit must take a Battle-shock test, subtracting 1 from the result if your unit is within 6” of it.
Take Them Alive.flavour: Aiming to maim rather than slag, and employing psychotropic or paralysing venoms, the Kabalites seek to incapacitate their victims so that they too may be taken as plunder.

Opportunistic Thieves.name: OPPORTUNISTIC THIEVES
Opportunistic Thieves.target: One KABAL unit from your army that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
Opportunistic Thieves.effect: Select one objective marker you do not control that is visible to your unit. Your unit can make a Normal move of up to D6", but if it does, every model in that unit must end that move as close as possible to that objective marker.
Opportunistic Thieves.text:
WHEN: End of your Fight phase.

TARGET: One KABAL unit from your army that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.

EFFECT: Select one objective marker you do not control that is visible to your unit. Your unit can make a Normal move of up to D6", but if it does, every model in that unit must end that move as close as possible to that objective marker.
Opportunistic Thieves.flavour: Any undefended source of riches or power is fair game to these fast-moving raiders.

enhancements.name: Dark Charisma
enhancements.text: The bearer has an Objective Control characteristic of 5 and you can re-roll Battle-shock tests taken for the bearer.

enhancements.name: Malevolent Cunning
enhancements.text: The first time in each battle round that your opponent targets a unit from their army that is within 3" of the bearer with a Stratagem, increase that Stratagems cost by 1CP for that usage.

rule.name: Feast of Pain
rule.text:
Units from your army with the Power From Pain ability retain that ability and gain this one.

At the start of the battle, you gain 1 Pain token.

rule.name: Appetite for Adulation
rule.text: In the Fight phase, if two or more enemy units were destroyed by DRUKHARI units from your army that phase, you gain 1 Pain token. In addition, each time a WYCH CULT unit from your army becomes Empowered in the Fight phase, until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in that unit have the [ANTi-iNFANTRY 4+] ability.

Hyperagility.name: HYPERAGILITY
Hyperagility.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Hyperagility.target: One WYCH CULT unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Hyperagility.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll and subtract 1 from the Wound roll.
Hyperagility.text:
WHEN: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One WYCH CULT unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll and subtract 1 from the Wound roll.
Hyperagility.flavour: Driven by combat drugs and the elation of their victims'fear and pain, the Wyches weave around their enemies' blades with easy scorn.

Toying with the Prey.name: TOYING WITH THE PREY
Toying with the Prey.when: Fight phase, just after a WYCH CULT unit from your army has fought.
Toying with the Prey.effect: If your unit destroyed one or more enemy models this phase, select one of those enemy models. Until the end of your opponent’s next turn, subtract 1 from the Objective Control characteristic of models in that enemy model's unit (to a minimum of l).
Toying with the Prey.text:
WHEN: Fight phase, just after a WYCH CULT unit from your army has fought.

TARGET: That WYCH CULT unit.

EFFECT: If your unit destroyed one or more enemy models this phase, select one of those enemy models. Until the end of your opponent’s next turn, subtract 1 from the Objective Control characteristic of models in that enemy model's unit (to a minimum of l).
Toying with the Prey.flavour: More than simply besting their victims in combat, the Wyches slowly take them apart, one perfectly placed cut and slice at a time, making a terrifying example to shatter enemy morale.

No Obstacle.name: NO OBSTACLE
No Obstacle.target: One WYCH CULT unit from your army that opened a Hatchway this turn.
No Obstacle.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit can declare a charge that includes one or more targets that are not visible to it, provided each of those units that are not visible to it are wholly on the opposite side of that Hatchway from your unit.
No Obstacle.text:
WHEN: Your Charge phase.

TARGET: One WYCH CULT unit from your army that opened a Hatchway this turn.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, your unit can declare a charge that includes one or more targets that are not visible to it, provided each of those units that are not visible to it are wholly on the opposite side of that Hatchway from your unit.
No Obstacle.flavour: Scenting their prey's fear sweat, tracking their fluttering heartbeats, the Wyches beardown unerringly on their victims through corridors and chambers.

Phantasm Grenades.name: PHANTASM GRENADES
Phantasm Grenades.when: Your Movement phase, just after a WYCH CULT unit from your army ends a Normal move, before any enemy units fire Overwatch.
Phantasm Grenades.effect: Select one enemy unit within 9" of and visible to your unit. That enemy unit must take a Battle-shock test, subtracting 1 from the result: if failed, until the end of the turn, that enemy unit cannot fire Overwatch.
Phantasm Grenades.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase, just after a WYCH CULT unit from your army ends a Normal move, before any enemy units fire Overwatch.

TARGET: That WYCH CULT unit.

EFFECT: Select one enemy unit within 9" of and visible to your unit. That enemy unit must take a Battle-shock test, subtracting 1 from the result: if failed, until the end of the turn, that enemy unit cannot fire Overwatch.
Phantasm Grenades.flavour: These hallucinogenic atomisers spew clouds of nightmare-inducing gasses that leave the foe glassy-eyed and reeling.

enhancements.name: Stimm-Fervour
enhancements.text: The bearer is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.

enhancements.name: Blood-Drenched Champion
enhancements.text: In the Battle-shock step of your opponent’s Command phase, for each enemy unit that is below its Starting Strength and is within Engagement Range of the bearer, that unit must take a Battle-shock test. If that enemy unit is also Below Half-strength, subtract 1 from that test. This Enhancement cannot cause a unit to take two Battle-shock tests in the same phase.

rule.name: Feast of Pain
rule.text:
Units from your army with the Power From Pain ability retain that ability and gain this one.

At the start of the battle, you gain 1 Pain token.

rule.name: Regenerative Agony
rule.text: Each time four or more Feel No Pain rolls are successful for HAEMONCULUS COVENS models from your army in a single phase, you gain 1 Pain token. In addition, each battle round, the first time a HAEMONCULUS COVENS unit from your army becomes Empowered in that battle round, roll one D6: on a 2-5, one model in that unit regains 1 lost wound or, if that unit has the WRACKS keyword, one destroyed model is returned to it with its full wounds remaining; on a 6, one model in that unit regains up to 2 lost wounds or, if that unit has the WRACKS keyword, one destroyed model is returned to it with its full wounds remaining.

Horrifying Form.name: HORRIFYING FORM
Horrifying Form.when: End of any phase, when an objective marker Secured by your army would be Seized by an enemy unit.
Horrifying Form.target: One HAEMONCULUS COVENS unit from your army within range of that objective marker.
Horrifying Form.effect: Until the end of your next turn, while you have one or more DRUKHARI units within range of that objective marker (excluding Battle-shocked units), that objective marker remains Secured by your army and cannot be Seized by enemy units.
Horrifying Form.restrictions: You can only use this Stratagem once per battle round.
Horrifying Form.text:
WHEN: End of any phase, when an objective marker Secured by your army would be Seized by an enemy unit.

TARGET: One HAEMONCULUS COVENS unit from your army within range of that objective marker.

EFFECT: Until the end of your next turn, while you have one or more DRUKHARI units within range of that objective marker (excluding Battle-shocked units), that objective marker remains Secured by your army and cannot be Seized by enemy units.

RESTRICTIONS: You can only use this Stratagem once per battle round.
Horrifying Form.flavour: The hulking monsters of the Haemonculus Covens are terrifying indeed, cowing enemy warriors with their grotesque and intimidating forms.

Unfeeling Abominations.name: UNFEELING ABOMINATIONS
Unfeeling Abominations.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Unfeeling Abominations.target: One HAEMONCULUS COVENS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
Unfeeling Abominations.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6, adding 1 if your unit has the GROTESQUES keyword: on a 4+, do not remove the destroyed model from play; it can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.
Unfeeling Abominations.restrictions: If your unit has the GROTESQUES keyword, until the end of the phase, it loses the Mindless Killing Machines ability.
Unfeeling Abominations.text:
WHEN: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One HAEMONCULUS COVENS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6, adding 1 if your unit has the GROTESQUES keyword: on a 4+, do not remove the destroyed model from play; it can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.

RESTRICTIONS: If your unit has the GROTESQUES keyword, until the end of the phase, it loses the Mindless Killing Machines ability.
Unfeeling Abominations.flavour: The creations of the Haemonculi are capable of enduring terrible wounds and continuing to fight.

Moulded Musculature.name: MOULDED MUSCULATURE
Moulded Musculature.target: One HAEMONCULUS COVENS unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
Moulded Musculature.effect: Select any number of models in your unit. Until the end of the phase, improve the Strength and Armour Penetration characteristics of melee weapons equipped by the selected models by 1, and each time you select targets for attacks made by those models, they must target an enemy unit that is wholly on the opposite side of a Hatchway from them.
Moulded Musculature.text:
WHEN: Fight phase.

TARGET: One HAEMONCULUS COVENS unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.

EFFECT: Select any number of models in your unit. Until the end of the phase, improve the Strength and Armour Penetration characteristics of melee weapons equipped by the selected models by 1, and each time you select targets for attacks made by those models, they must target an enemy unit that is wholly on the opposite side of a Hatchway from them.
Moulded Musculature.flavour: The muscular fleshcraft monstrosities fielded by the Haemonculi can punch through hatchways and bulkheads to reach their cowering victims.

Terrifying Aura.name: TERRIFYING AURA
Terrifying Aura.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Terrifying Aura.target: One HAEMONCULUS COVENS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks and is within 6" of the attacking unit.
Terrifying Aura.effect: That enemy unit must take a Leadership test, subtracting 1 if it is within 3" of your unit: if failed, until the end of the phase, each time a model in that enemy unit makes an attack that targets your unit, an unmodified Hit roll of 6 is required to score a hit, irrespective of the attacking weapon’s Ballistic Skill or any modifiers.
Terrifying Aura.text:
WHEN: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One HAEMONCULUS COVENS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks and is within 6" of the attacking unit.

EFFECT: That enemy unit must take a Leadership test, subtracting 1 if it is within 3" of your unit: if failed, until the end of the phase, each time a model in that enemy unit makes an attack that targets your unit, an unmodified Hit roll of 6 is required to score a hit, irrespective of the attacking weapon’s Ballistic Skill or any modifiers.
Terrifying Aura.flavour: The disturbing nature of these creatures causes weapons to quiver, even in the hands of veteran soldiers.

enhancements.name: Rending Chain-Flails
enhancements.text: Each time an enemy unit within Engagement Range of the bearer is selected to Fall Back, roll one D6: on a 2-4, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound; on a 5+, that enemy unit suffers 2 mortal wounds.

enhancements.name: Vile Surgeon
enhancements.text: The bearers Haemonculus tools and scissorhands have a Damage characteristic of 3 while targeting CHARACTER units.

insensibletopain.name: INSENSIBLE TO PAIN
insensibletopain.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
insensibletopain.target: One HAEMONCULUS COVENS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
insensibletopain.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack is allocated to a model in your unit, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of that attack.
insensibletopain.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One HAEMONCULUS COVENS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack is allocated to a model in your unit, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of that attack.
insensibletopain.flavour: The twisted creations of the haemonculus covens are uncaring of all but the most mortal injuries.

fightingshadows.name: FIGHTING SHADOWS
fightingshadows.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
fightingshadows.target: One DRUKHARI unit from your army (excluding HAEMONCULUS COVENS units) that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
fightingshadows.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.
fightingshadows.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One DRUKHARI unit from your army (excluding HAEMONCULUS COVENS units) that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.
fightingshadows.flavour: Even attempting to strike the Drukhari is like trying to lay a blade to smoke, so sly and swift are they.

instinctivespite.name: INSTINCTIVE SPITE
instinctivespite.when: Start of your Shooting phase or the start of the Fight phase.
instinctivespite.target: Up to two DRUKHARI BATTLELINE units from your army, or one other DRUKHARI unit from your army.
instinctivespite.effect: You can spend 1 Pain token. Until the end of the phase, each time a model in each of those units makes an attack that targets an enemy unit that is Below Half-strength, add 1 to the Hit roll. If you spent 1 Pain token, add 1 to the Wound roll as well.
instinctivespite.text:
WHEN: Start of your Shooting phase or the start of the Fight phase.

TARGET: Up to two DRUKHARI BATTLELINE units from your army, or one other DRUKHARI unit from your army.

EFFECT: You can spend 1 Pain token. Until the end of the phase, each time a model in each of those units makes an attack that targets an enemy unit that is Below Half-strength, add 1 to the Hit roll. If you spent 1 Pain token, add 1 to the Wound roll as well.
instinctivespite.flavour: It is hardwired into the Drukhari psyche to prey upon weakened and suffering victims.
