darkharvest.name: DARK HARVEST
darkharvest.target: Up to two WRACKS units from your army, or one other DRUKHARI unit from your army.
darkharvest.effect: Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in each of those units have the [LETHAL HITS] ability.
darkharvest.text:
WHEN: Start of the Fight phase.

TARGET: Up to two WRACKS units from your army, or one other DRUKHARI unit from your army.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in each of those units have the [LETHAL HITS] ability.
darkharvest.flavour: Wicked sickles and serrated blades hack through writhing flesh as the Drukhari harvest agony and suffering.

eagerforthekill.name: EAGER FOR THE KILL
eagerforthekill.target: Up to two WYCHES units from your army, or one other DRUKHARI unit from your army, that have not been selected to move this phase.
eagerforthekill.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time one of those units Advances, do not make an Advance roll for it. Instead, until the end of the phase, add 6" to the Move characteristic of models in that unit (this is not cumulative with the REAVERS’ Matchless Swiftness ability).
eagerforthekill.text:
WHEN: Start of your Movement phase.

TARGET: Up to two WYCHES units from your army, or one other DRUKHARI unit from your army, that have not been selected to move this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time one of those units Advances, do not make an Advance roll for it. Instead, until the end of the phase, add 6" to the Move characteristic of models in that unit (this is not cumulative with the REAVERS’ Matchless Swiftness ability).
eagerforthekill.flavour: The exhilarating promise of bloodshed goads these warriors into battle with preternatural haste.

raidandfade.name: RAID AND FADE
raidandfade.target: Up to two KABALITE WARRIORS units from your army, or one other DRUKHARI unit from your army (excluding SCOURGES and AIRCRAFT).
raidandfade.effect: Each of those units can make a Normal move of up to 6".
raidandfade.restrictions: You cannot select units that are within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units. Until the end of the turn, those units are not eligible to declare a charge.
raidandfade.text:
WHEN: End of your Shooting phase.

TARGET: Up to two KABALITE WARRIORS units from your army, or one other DRUKHARI unit from your army (excluding SCOURGES and AIRCRAFT).

EFFECT: Each of those units can make a Normal move of up to 6".

RESTRICTIONS: You cannot select units that are within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units. Until the end of the turn, those units are not eligible to declare a charge.
raidandfade.flavour: The Drukhari are masters at using hit-and-run tactics, engaging a target with a flurry of shots before quickly manoeuvring into cover or out of sight.

viciousblades.name: VICIOUS BLADES
viciousblades.when: Fight phase, just after a DRUKHARI TRANSPORT from your army has selected its targets.
viciousblades.effect: After your TRANSPORT has fought, select one enemy unit that was the target of one or more of those attacks and roll one D6 for each model embarked within your TRANSPORT, adding 1 to the result if that embarked model is a WRACKS model: for each 5+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound (to a maximum of 6 mortal wounds).
viciousblades.text:
WHEN: Fight phase, just after a DRUKHARI TRANSPORT from your army has selected its targets.

TARGET: That TRANSPORT.

EFFECT: After your TRANSPORT has fought, select one enemy unit that was the target of one or more of those attacks and roll one D6 for each model embarked within your TRANSPORT, adding 1 to the result if that embarked model is a WRACKS model: for each 5+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound (to a maximum of 6 mortal wounds).
viciousblades.flavour: Wielding a horrifying array of hooked boarding blades, barbed lariats and other specialised tools of agony, these warriors hack and slash at their foes even as their transport skims low overhead.

wraithlikeretreat.name: WRAITHLIKE RETREAT
wraithlikeretreat.target: One DRUKHARI INFANTRY unit from your army that fought this phase.
wraithlikeretreat.effect: Your unit can make a Normal or Fall Back move, but unless it is a WYCHES unit, it must end that move wholly within 3" horizontally and 5" vertically of a friendly DRUKHARI TRANSPORT and must embark within that TRANSPORT at the end of that move (otherwise, it cannot make that move). Your unit can embark within that TRANSPORT in a turn it disembarked from that TRANSPORT.
wraithlikeretreat.text:
WHEN: End of the Fight phase.

TARGET: One DRUKHARI INFANTRY unit from your army that fought this phase.

EFFECT: Your unit can make a Normal or Fall Back move, but unless it is a WYCHES unit, it must end that move wholly within 3" horizontally and 5" vertically of a friendly DRUKHARI TRANSPORT and must embark within that TRANSPORT at the end of that move (otherwise, it cannot make that move). Your unit can embark within that TRANSPORT in a turn it disembarked from that TRANSPORT.
wraithlikeretreat.flavour: Employing smoke grenades, paralysing mists or simple cunning and agility, these warriors slip away like spectres.

pounceontheprey.name: POUNCE ON THE PREY
pounceontheprey.when: Your Movement phase, just after a DRUKHARI INFANTRY unit from your army disembarks from a TRANSPORT that made a Normal move this phase.
pounceontheprey.effect: Your unit makes an assault disembark move (Core Rules, 18.06) for that disembarkation.
pounceontheprey.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase, just after a DRUKHARI INFANTRY unit from your army disembarks from a TRANSPORT that made a Normal move this phase.

TARGET: That INFANTRY unit.

EFFECT: Your unit makes an assault disembark move (Core Rules, 18.06) for that disembarkation.
pounceontheprey.flavour: Incredible alien agility and a delight in taking wild risks help these warriors to leap acrobatically from their skimming transports directly into battle.

skyborneannihilation.name: SKYBORNE ANNIHILATION
skyborneannihilation.target: One DRUKHARI unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase and that disembarked from a TRANSPORT this turn.
skyborneannihilation.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability, or the [SUSTAINED HITS 2] ability if your unit is a KABALITE WARRIORS or HAND OF THE ARCHON unit.
skyborneannihilation.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase.

TARGET: One DRUKHARI unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase and that disembarked from a TRANSPORT this turn.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability, or the [SUSTAINED HITS 2] ability if your unit is a KABALITE WARRIORS or HAND OF THE ARCHON unit.
skyborneannihilation.flavour: These warriors are well versed in raining suppressing fire on the foe even as they close with them from on high, shredding defences and leaving the survivors easy prey for the raid.

swoopingmockery.name: SWOOPING MOCKERY
swoopingmockery.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
swoopingmockery.target: One DRUKHARI TRANSPORT from your army that is within 8" of that enemy unit.
swoopingmockery.effect: Your TRANSPORT can make a Normal move of up to 6".
swoopingmockery.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.

TARGET: One DRUKHARI TRANSPORT from your army that is within 8" of that enemy unit.

EFFECT: Your TRANSPORT can make a Normal move of up to 6".
swoopingmockery.flavour: The crew of this skimmer delight in evading and taunting their enemies with mocking ease.

nightshield.name: NIGHT SHIELD
nightshield.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
nightshield.target: One DRUKHARI VEHICLE unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
nightshield.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have a 4+ invulnerable save.
nightshield.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One DRUKHARI VEHICLE unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have a 4+ invulnerable save.
nightshield.flavour: These powerful Drukhari devices occlude their raiding vehicles from physical sight, targeting sensors, and even psychic senses.

berserkfugue.name: BERSERK FUGUE
berserkfugue.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
berserkfugue.target: One WYCH CULT unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
berserkfugue.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, do not remove it from play. The destroyed model can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.
berserkfugue.text:
WHEN: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One WYCH CULT unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, do not remove it from play. The destroyed model can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.
berserkfugue.flavour: The cult's gladiators enter a killing trance when combat is joined, allowing them to fight on through the most grievous hurts with undimmed ferocity.

deadlydebut.name: DEADLY DEBUT
deadlydebut.target: One DRUKHARI unit from your army that made a Charge move this turn and has not been selected to fight this phase.
deadlydebut.effect: Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [LETHAL HITS] ability. If your unit is a WYCHES unit, until the end of the phase, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in your unit by 1 as well.
deadlydebut.text:
WHEN: Fight phase.

TARGET: One DRUKHARI unit from your army that made a Charge move this turn and has not been selected to fight this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [LETHAL HITS] ability. If your unit is a WYCHES unit, until the end of the phase, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in your unit by 1 as well.
deadlydebut.flavour: Imitating Lelith Hesperax, these warriors begin their gladiatorial bout with an opening so spectacularly violent that none can fail to be impressed.

feignedweakness.name: FEIGNED WEAKNESS
feignedweakness.when: Your Movement phase, just after a DRUKHARI unit from your army Falls Back.
feignedweakness.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in turn in which it Fell Back.
feignedweakness.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase, just after a DRUKHARI unit from your army Falls Back.

TARGET: That DRUKHARI unit.

EFFECT: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in turn in which it Fell Back.
feignedweakness.flavour: Employing a common ruse from the arenas, the Drukhari appear to cower, wounded and exhausted, before surging back at their overconfident opponents with blades and fangs bared.

preternaturalagility.name: PRETERNATURAL AGILITY
preternaturalagility.when: Start of your Movement or Charge phase.
preternaturalagility.target: One WYCH CULT unit from your army.
preternaturalagility.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit makes a Normal, Advance or Charge move, you can ignore any or all modifiers to its Move characteristic and to Advance and Charge rolls made for it and, until the end of the turn, each time a model in your unit makes such a move, it can move horizontally through models (when doing so, such a model can move within Engagement Range of such models but cannot end a Normal or Advance move within Engagement Range of them).
preternaturalagility.text:
WHEN: Start of your Movement or Charge phase.

TARGET: One WYCH CULT unit from your army.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit makes a Normal, Advance or Charge move, you can ignore any or all modifiers to its Move characteristic and to Advance and Charge rolls made for it and, until the end of the turn, each time a model in your unit makes such a move, it can move horizontally through models (when doing so, such a model can move within Engagement Range of such models but cannot end a Normal or Advance move within Engagement Range of them).
preternaturalagility.flavour: Bounding and weaving, the Wyches cross the battlefield with unmatched acrobatic agility.

achallengemet.name: A CHALLENGE MET
achallengemet.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a fall-back move.
achallengemet.target: One friendly unengaged WYCH CULT unit that is within 6" of that enemy unit.
achallengemet.effect: Declare a charge with your unit. When selecting charge targets, you can only select enemy units that made a fall-back move this phase and are within the maximum distance.
achallengemet.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a fall-back move.

TARGET: One friendly unengaged WYCH CULT unit that is within 6" of that enemy unit.

EFFECT: Declare a charge with your unit. When selecting charge targets, you can only select enemy units that made a fall-back move this phase and are within the maximum distance.
achallengemet.flavour: The foe's advance is not something to be wary of but rather an opportunity to be seized.

acrobaticdisplay.name: ACROBATIC DISPLAY
acrobaticdisplay.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
acrobaticdisplay.target: One WYCH CULT unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
acrobaticdisplay.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have a 5+ invulnerable save.
acrobaticdisplay.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One WYCH CULT unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have a 5+ invulnerable save.
acrobaticdisplay.flavour: Moving so quickly they seem to blur, the Wyches evade incoming fire with contemptuous elegance.

postmortality.name: POSTMORTALITY
postmortality.target: One HAEMONCULUS model from your army that was just destroyed. You can use this Stratagem on that model even though it was just destroyed.
postmortality.effect: Spend 1-3 Pain tokens. At the end of the phase, set up the destroyed model on the battlefield, unengaged and as close as possible to where it was destroyed. That model is not part of an attached unit and its unit has a starting strength of 1. That model has a number of wounds remaining equal to the number of Pain tokens you just spent.
postmortality.restrictions: You cannot use this Stratagem if you have 0 Pain tokens, and you cannot target the same HAEMONCULUS model with this Stratagem more than once per battle.
postmortality.text:
WHEN: Any phase.

TARGET: One HAEMONCULUS model from your army that was just destroyed. You can use this Stratagem on that model even though it was just destroyed.

EFFECT: Spend 1-3 Pain tokens. At the end of the phase, set up the destroyed model on the battlefield, unengaged and as close as possible to where it was destroyed. That model is not part of an attached unit and its unit has a starting strength of 1. That model has a number of wounds remaining equal to the number of Pain tokens you just spent.

RESTRICTION: You cannot use this Stratagem if you have 0 Pain tokens, and you cannot target the same HAEMONCULUS model with this Stratagem more than once per battle.
postmortality.flavour: To the greatest Haemonculi, death is but an intriguing and temporary state to be experienced.

symphonyofsuffering.name: SYMPHONY OF SUFFERING
symphonyofsuffering.when: Fight phase, just after a DRUKHARI unit from your army destroys an enemy unit.
symphonyofsuffering.effect: Each enemy unit within 9" of and visible to your unit must take a Battle-shock test, subtracting 1 from that test if your unit is a HAEMONCULUS COVENS unit.
symphonyofsuffering.text:
WHEN: Fight phase, just after a DRUKHARI unit from your army destroys an enemy unit.

TARGET: That DRUKHARI unit.

EFFECT: Each enemy unit within 9" of and visible to your unit must take a Battle-shock test, subtracting 1 from that test if your unit is a HAEMONCULUS COVENS unit.
symphonyofsuffering.flavour: So extreme are the foe's agonies that they spread a shock wave of terror through their comrades.

poisonersart.name: POISONER’S ART
poisonersart.when: Fight phase, just after a HAEMONCULUS COVENS unit from your army has fought.
poisonersart.effect: Select one enemy unit (excluding VEHICLES) hit by one or more of your unit’s attacks this phase. Until the end of the battle, that enemy unit is poisoned. At the start of each Command phase, roll one D6 for each poisoned unit on the battlefield: on a 4+, that unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.
poisonersart.text:
WHEN: Fight phase, just after a HAEMONCULUS COVENS unit from your army has fought.

TARGET: That HAEMONCULUS COVENS unit.

EFFECT: Select one enemy unit (excluding VEHICLES) hit by one or more of your unit’s attacks this phase. Until the end of the battle, that enemy unit is poisoned. At the start of each Command phase, roll one D6 for each poisoned unit on the battlefield: on a 4+, that unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.
poisonersart.flavour: The venoms wielded by these warriors are potent enough to impress Shaimesh himself.

distillersoffear.name: DISTILLERS OF FEAR
distillersoffear.target: One HAEMONCULUS COVENS unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
distillersoffear.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets an enemy unit that is Battle-shocked, that attack has the [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] ability.
distillersoffear.text:
WHEN: Fight phase.

TARGET: One HAEMONCULUS COVENS unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets an enemy unit that is Battle-shocked, that attack has the [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] ability.
distillersoffear.flavour: By arcane syringe and unholy invocation, the enemy's terror is syphoned out of their bodies, leaving them as little more than contorted husks.

connoisseursofpain.name: CONNOISSEURS OF PAIN
connoisseursofpain.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
connoisseursofpain.target: One DRUKHARI unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
connoisseursofpain.effect: Spend 1 Pain token. Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1. At the end of the phase, if your unit is still on the battlefield and it is a HAEMONCULUS COVENS unit, you gain 1 Pain token.
connoisseursofpain.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One DRUKHARI unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Spend 1 Pain token. Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1. At the end of the phase, if your unit is still on the battlefield and it is a HAEMONCULUS COVENS unit, you gain 1 Pain token.
connoisseursofpain.flavour: These epicureans of extreme sensation revel in their agonies as much as those of the foe.

enfoldingnightmare.name: ENFOLDING NIGHTMARE
enfoldingnightmare.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot.
enfoldingnightmare.target: One HAEMONCULUS COVENS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
enfoldingnightmare.effect: Your unit can make a surge move of up to D6".
enfoldingnightmare.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot.

TARGET: One HAEMONCULUS COVENS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Your unit can make a surge move of up to D6".
enfoldingnightmare.flavour: Even as the prey seek to drive the covenites back with hails of firepower, the horrors lurch closer.

doublecross.name: DOUBLE-CROSS
doublecross.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
doublecross.target: One KABAL or BLADES FOR HIRE unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks, and one friendly DRUKHARI unit (excluding VEHICLES).
doublecross.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time you would allocate an attack to a model in your KABAL or BLADES FOR HIRE unit, if your DRUKHARI unit is within Engagement Range of the attacking model, no saving throw is made for that attack; instead, your DRUKHARI unit suffers a number of mortal wounds equal to the Damage characteristic of that attack.
doublecross.text:
WHEN: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One KABAL or BLADES FOR HIRE unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks, and one friendly DRUKHARI unit (excluding VEHICLES).

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time you would allocate an attack to a model in your KABAL or BLADES FOR HIRE unit, if your DRUKHARI unit is within Engagement Range of the attacking model, no saving throw is made for that attack; instead, your DRUKHARI unit suffers a number of mortal wounds equal to the Damage characteristic of that attack.
doublecross.flavour: What better way to eliminate rivals than tricking them into taking the blade meant for your ribs?

takenalive.name: TAKEN ALIVE
takenalive.target: One DRUKHARI unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
takenalive.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, add 1 to the Hit roll. If your Contract unit is destroyed as a result of those attacks, every unit in your opponent’s army must take a Battle-shock test. You cannot gain more than 3 Pain tokens as a result of failed Battle-shock tests caused by this Stratagem.
takenalive.text:
WHEN: Fight phase.

TARGET: One DRUKHARI unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, add 1 to the Hit roll. If your Contract unit is destroyed as a result of those attacks, every unit in your opponent’s army must take a Battle-shock test. You cannot gain more than 3 Pain tokens as a result of failed Battle-shock tests caused by this Stratagem.
takenalive.flavour: Borne away screaming into the shadows, everyone knows these unfortunates face a dreadful fate.

tailoredtoxins.name: TAILORED TOXINS
tailoredtoxins.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
tailoredtoxins.target: One KABAL or BLADES FOR HIRE unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
tailoredtoxins.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets your Contract unit, an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.
tailoredtoxins.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.

TARGET: One KABAL or BLADES FOR HIRE unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets your Contract unit, an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.
tailoredtoxins.flavour: Specially prepared for their chosen prey, these malignant poisons are the anathema of their targets.

enemieswithoutnumber.name: ENEMIES WITHOUT NUMBER
enemieswithoutnumber.when: Your Command phase, just after you complete a Contract.
enemieswithoutnumber.target: One ARCHON WARLORD from your army.
enemieswithoutnumber.effect: Select one new Contract (this can be one you have already completed), then select one unit from your opponent’s army that is on the battlefield and matches the ‘Contract’ description in that Contract. Until that Contract is completed, that unit is your Contract unit and the Murderous Agenda Detachment rule applies as normal.
enemieswithoutnumber.text:
WHEN: Your Command phase, just after you complete a Contract.

TARGET: One ARCHON WARLORD from your army.

EFFECT: Select one new Contract (this can be one you have already completed), then select one unit from your opponent’s army that is on the battlefield and matches the ‘Contract’ description in that Contract. Until that Contract is completed, that unit is your Contract unit and the Murderous Agenda Detachment rule applies as normal.
enemieswithoutnumber.flavour: This Archon’s personal kill list of rivals, nemeses and victims is virtually never-ending.

makingapoint.name: MAKING A POINT
makingapoint.target: One KABALITE WARRIORS or HAND OF THE ARCHON unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
makingapoint.effect: Until the end of the phase, improve the Ballistic Skill and Armour Penetration characteristics of ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit by 1.
makingapoint.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase.

TARGET: One KABALITE WARRIORS or HAND OF THE ARCHON unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, improve the Ballistic Skill and Armour Penetration characteristics of ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit by 1.
makingapoint.flavour: Whether seeking to impress a watching Archon, show up rivals or revel in their supremacy, these marksmen fire for spiteful effect.

deadlydeceivers.name: DEADLY DECEIVERS
deadlydeceivers.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
deadlydeceivers.target: One KABAL or BLADES FOR HIRE unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
deadlydeceivers.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit can only be selected as the target of a ranged attack if the attacking model is within 18".
deadlydeceivers.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One KABAL or BLADES FOR HIRE unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, your unit can only be selected as the target of a ranged attack if the attacking model is within 18".
deadlydeceivers.flavour: A life lived amidst the shadowed spires of Commorragh teaches many ways to creep up on your enemies, unseen and unsuspected.

maliciousfrenzy.name: MALICIOUS FRENZY
maliciousfrenzy.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
maliciousfrenzy.target: One DRUKHARI or HARLEQUINS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
maliciousfrenzy.effect: Select [LETHAL HITS] or [SUSTAINED HITS 1]. Until the end of the phase, weapons equipped by models in your unit have the selected ability.
maliciousfrenzy.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.

TARGET: One DRUKHARI or HARLEQUINS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.

EFFECT: Select [LETHAL HITS] or [SUSTAINED HITS 1]. Until the end of the phase, weapons equipped by models in your unit have the selected ability.
maliciousfrenzy.flavour: Jealous competition descends into frenzied carnage as the kill count climbs higher and the intoxicating screams of the dying fill the air.

fatefulrole.name: FATEFUL ROLE
fatefulrole.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
fatefulrole.target: One DRUKHARI or HARLEQUINS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
fatefulrole.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6, adding 1 to the result if that unit is losing the wager: on a 4+, do not remove it from play. That destroyed model can fight after the attacking model’s unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.
fatefulrole.text:
WHEN: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One DRUKHARI or HARLEQUINS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6, adding 1 to the result if that unit is losing the wager: on a 4+, do not remove it from play. That destroyed model can fight after the attacking model’s unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.
fatefulrole.flavour: These warriors are so absorbed by their desire to win the wager that they risk death to land their killing blows.

murdererscircus.name: MURDERER’S CIRCUS
murdererscircus.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
murdererscircus.target: One DRUKHARI or HARLEQUINS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
murdererscircus.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.
murdererscircus.text:
WHEN: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One DRUKHARI or HARLEQUINS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.
murdererscircus.flavour: In bounding leaps and graceful pirouettes, the cavalcade of capricious killers bounds through hails of fire, cackling gleefully as they come.

shortentheodds.name: SHORTEN THE ODDS
shortentheodds.when: Your Movement phase, just after a DRUKHARI or HARLEQUINS unit from your army has Advanced.
shortentheodds.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.
shortentheodds.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase, just after a DRUKHARI or HARLEQUINS unit from your army has Advanced.

TARGET: That unit.

EFFECT: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.
shortentheodds.flavour: Having selected their victims, these killers strive to complete the kill with speed and brutality whilst moving ever closer to winning their macabre wager.

scintillatingtempo.name: SCINTILLATING TEMPO
scintillatingtempo.when: Your Movement phase or your Charge phase, just after a DRUKHARI or HARLEQUINS unit from your army is selected to make a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move, is set up on the battlefield, or declares a charge.
scintillatingtempo.effect: Until the end of the turn, enemy units cannot use the Fire Overwatch Stratagem to shoot at your unit.
scintillatingtempo.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase or your Charge phase, just after a DRUKHARI or HARLEQUINS unit from your army is selected to make a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move, is set up on the battlefield, or declares a charge.

TARGET: That unit.

EFFECT: Until the end of the turn, enemy units cannot use the Fire Overwatch Stratagem to shoot at your unit.
scintillatingtempo.flavour: Commorrite or Harlequin, these lithe combatants move with stunning speed, darting in and out of firing lines before their foes can raise their weapons.

dancemacabre.name: DANCE MACABRE
dancemacabre.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
dancemacabre.target: One DRUKHARI INFANTRY or HARLEQUINS INFANTRY unit from your army that is within 8" of that enemy unit.
dancemacabre.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to D6". If your unit is currently losing the wager, it can make a Normal move of up to 6" instead.
dancemacabre.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.

TARGET: One DRUKHARI INFANTRY or HARLEQUINS INFANTRY unit from your army that is within 8" of that enemy unit.

EFFECT: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to D6". If your unit is currently losing the wager, it can make a Normal move of up to 6" instead.
dancemacabre.flavour: The saedath’s victims become unwitting partners in a frantic dance of ghastly slaughter.

plannedstrikes.name: PLANNED STRIKES
plannedstrikes.when: Fight phase, when a friendly WYCH CULT unit is selected to fight.
plannedstrikes.effect: Your unit’s melee attacks have [LETHAL HITS].
plannedstrikes.text:
WHEN: Fight phase, when a friendly WYCH CULT unit is selected to fight.

TARGET: That WYCH CULT unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s melee attacks have [LETHAL HITS].
plannedstrikes.flavour: Murderous rehearsals ensure that those who survive can bring down the most resilient of prey in puissant displays.

sculptingthestage.name: SCULPTING THE STAGE
sculptingthestage.when: Your Movement phase, when a friendly WYCH CULT unit is selected to make an advance/fall-back move.
sculptingthestage.effect: That move does not prevent your unit from being eligible to start an action.
sculptingthestage.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase, when a friendly WYCH CULT unit is selected to make an advance/fall-back move.

TARGET: That WYCH CULT unit.

EFFECT: That move does not prevent your unit from being eligible to start an action.
sculptingthestage.flavour: Gauche are the gladiators who kill too relentlessly. Preparing the stage with a variety of torments in order to build the tension for a delightful crescendo is the mark of a true artist.

prioritisedvictim.name: PRIORITISED VICTIM
prioritisedvictim.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly BLADES FOR HIRE/KABAL unit targets a CHARACTER unit.
prioritisedvictim.effect:
Your unit’s attacks that target a CHARACTER unit can:

- Re-roll hit rolls of 1.

- Re-roll wound rolls of 1.
prioritisedvictim.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly BLADES FOR HIRE/KABAL unit targets a CHARACTER unit.

TARGET: That BLADES FOR HIRE/KABAL unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s attacks that target a CHARACTER unit can:

- Re-roll hit rolls of 1.

- Re-roll wound rolls of 1.
prioritisedvictim.flavour: Contracts to annihilate, maim or capture singular victims of rarefied value are eagerly competed for by a kabal’s killers.

shadowsreach.name: SHADOWS’ REACH
shadowsreach.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly BLADES FOR HIRE/KABAL unit has shot.
shadowsreach.effect: Those attacks do not prevent your unit from being hidden.
shadowsreach.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly BLADES FOR HIRE/KABAL unit has shot.

TARGET: That BLADES FOR HIRE/KABAL unit.

EFFECT: Those attacks do not prevent your unit from being hidden.
shadowsreach.flavour: The capability of militant kabals to project their killing power is rightfully feared, as is the fact that the perpetrators can usually never be found.

killersfromthedarkspires.name: KILLERS FROM THE DARK SPIRES
killersfromthedarkspires.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly KABALITE WARRIORS unit is selected to shoot.
killersfromthedarkspires.effect: Your unit’s ranged attacks have [IGNORES COVER].
killersfromthedarkspires.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly KABALITE WARRIORS unit is selected to shoot.

TARGET: That KABALITE WARRIORS unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s ranged attacks have [IGNORES COVER].
killersfromthedarkspires.flavour: Defensive barriers or camouflage are little protection against those who have honed their talents hunting amongst the twisted and dark spires of their kabal’s territory.

saltingthewound.name: SALTING THE WOUND
saltingthewound.when: Fight phase, when a friendly CRONOS/TALOS unit is selected to fight.
saltingthewound.effect: Your unit’s attacks that target a battle-shocked unit have [DEVASTATING WOUNDS].
saltingthewound.text:
WHEN: Fight phase, when a friendly CRONOS/TALOS unit is selected to fight.

TARGET: That CRONOS/TALOS unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s attacks that target a battle-shocked unit have [DEVASTATING WOUNDS].
saltingthewound.flavour: Confusion, terror, and panic are triggers for a Haemonculus’ Engines of Pain, which stimulate them to drive their evil augmentations even deeper into the foe.

dividendsofagony.name: DIVIDENDS OF AGONY
dividendsofagony.when: Fight phase, when a friendly HAEMONCULUS COVENS unit destroys an enemy unit.
dividendsofagony.effect: Select one visible enemy unit within 12" of your unit. That enemy unit makes a battle-shock roll, with -1 to that battle-shock roll.
dividendsofagony.text:
WHEN: Fight phase, when a friendly HAEMONCULUS COVENS unit destroys an enemy unit.

TARGET: That HAEMONCULUS COVENS unit.

EFFECT: Select one visible enemy unit within 12" of your unit. That enemy unit makes a battle-shock roll, with -1 to that battle-shock roll.
dividendsofagony.flavour: Sharing is typically anathema to the self‑centred Drukhari, except where horror can be fruitfully reinvested in those marked for later harvest.

urgentmetamorphosis.name: URGENT METAMORPHOSIS
urgentmetamorphosis.when: Your Movement phase, when a friendly HAEMONCULUS COVENS unit is selected to make a fall-back move.
urgentmetamorphosis.effect: That move does not prevent your unit from being eligible to declare a charge.
urgentmetamorphosis.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase, when a friendly HAEMONCULUS COVENS unit is selected to make a fall-back move.

TARGET: That HAEMONCULUS COVENS unit.

EFFECT: That move does not prevent your unit from being eligible to declare a charge.
urgentmetamorphosis.flavour: The unhurried menace exuded by Covenites as they extricate themselves from gore‑slick foes can metamorphose in an instant back to pain‑hungry savagery.

shipboardshades.name: SHIPBOARD SHADES
shipboardshades.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
shipboardshades.target: One DRUKHARI unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
shipboardshades.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.
shipboardshades.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One DRUKHARI unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.
shipboardshades.flavour: Amidst the strobing lumens and gouting steam of voidship combat, the Drukhari flicker and flit like malevolent, half-seen shadows.

crewthieves.name: CREW-THIEVES
crewthieves.target: One WRACKS unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
crewthieves.effect: Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [ANTI-INFANTRY 3+] ability.
crewthieves.text:
WHEN: Fight phase.

TARGET: One WRACKS unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [ANTI-INFANTRY 3+] ability.
crewthieves.flavour: The fast-acting incapacitation toxins on the blades of these Wracks allow them to lay low the defenders, before dragging them away, alive but powerless, to a far more horrible fate than death.

voidshipgladiators.name: VOIDSHIP GLADIATORS
voidshipgladiators.target: One WYCHES unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.
voidshipgladiators.effect: Roll one D6: on a 2+, until the end of the turn, enemy units cannot fire Overwatch at your unit.
voidshipgladiators.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase.

TARGET: One WYCHES unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.

EFFECT: Roll one D6: on a 2+, until the end of the turn, enemy units cannot fire Overwatch at your unit.
voidshipgladiators.flavour: Treating the vessel they have boarded as just another arena to perform in, these Wyches turn every iota of their skill and agility to the task.

veteranpirates.name: VETERAN PIRATES
veteranpirates.when: Your Shooting phase, just after a KABALITE WARRIORS unit from your army has shot.
veteranpirates.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 3".
veteranpirates.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, just after a KABALITE WARRIORS unit from your army has shot.

TARGET: That KABALITE WARRIORS unit.

EFFECT: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 3".
veteranpirates.flavour: No strangers to shipboard warfare, these warriors are skilled in loosing volleys then vanishing swiftly back behind corners and bulkheads to avoid reprisals.

elusiveduellists.name: ELUSIVE DUELLISTS
elusiveduellists.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
elusiveduellists.target: One DRUKHARI unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
elusiveduellists.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll and, if your unit has the INCUBI keyword, models in your unit have a 4+ invulnerable save.
elusiveduellists.text:
WHEN: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One DRUKHARI unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll and, if your unit has the INCUBI keyword, models in your unit have a 4+ invulnerable save.
elusiveduellists.flavour: These warriors delight in the close-quarters blade-duels of boarding actions, weaving around their enemies' blows and cutting them down in droves.

deckplatesweepers.name: DECKPLATE SWEEPERS
deckplatesweepers.target: One KABAL unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
deckplatesweepers.effect: Until the end of the phase, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of splinter cannons, splinter rifles and splinter pistols equipped by models in your unit by 1.
deckplatesweepers.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase.

TARGET: One KABAL unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of splinter cannons, splinter rifles and splinter pistols equipped by models in your unit by 1.
deckplatesweepers.flavour: Indiscriminate hails of splinter fire fill chambers and corridors, leaving nowhere to hide in the enclosed space.

takethemalive.name: TAKE THEM ALIVE
takethemalive.when: Your Shooting phase, just after a KABAL unit from your army has shot.
takethemalive.effect: Select one enemy unit hit by one or more of your unit’s attacks this phase (excluding those made with Pistols). That enemy unit must take a Battle-shock test, subtracting 1 from the result if your unit is within 6” of it.
takethemalive.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, just after a KABAL unit from your army has shot.

TARGET: That KABAL unit.

EFFECT: Select one enemy unit hit by one or more of your unit’s attacks this phase (excluding those made with Pistols). That enemy unit must take a Battle-shock test, subtracting 1 from the result if your unit is within 6” of it.
takethemalive.flavour: Aiming to maim rather than slag, and employing psychotropic or paralysing venoms, the Kabalites seek to incapacitate their victims so that they too may be taken as plunder.

opportunisticthieves.name: OPPORTUNISTIC THIEVES
opportunisticthieves.target: One KABAL unit from your army that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
opportunisticthieves.effect: Select one objective marker you do not control that is visible to your unit. Your unit can make a Normal move of up to D6", but if it does, every model in that unit must end that move as close as possible to that objective marker.
opportunisticthieves.text:
WHEN: End of your Fight phase.

TARGET: One KABAL unit from your army that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.

EFFECT: Select one objective marker you do not control that is visible to your unit. Your unit can make a Normal move of up to D6", but if it does, every model in that unit must end that move as close as possible to that objective marker.
opportunisticthieves.flavour: Any undefended source of riches or power is fair game to these fast-moving raiders.

hyperagility.name: HYPERAGILITY
hyperagility.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
hyperagility.target: One WYCH CULT unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
hyperagility.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll and subtract 1 from the Wound roll.
hyperagility.text:
WHEN: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One WYCH CULT unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll and subtract 1 from the Wound roll.
hyperagility.flavour: Driven by combat drugs and the elation of their victims'fear and pain, the Wyches weave around their enemies' blades with easy scorn.

toyingwiththeprey.name: TOYING WITH THE PREY
toyingwiththeprey.when: Fight phase, just after a WYCH CULT unit from your army has fought.
toyingwiththeprey.effect: If your unit destroyed one or more enemy models this phase, select one of those enemy models. Until the end of your opponent’s next turn, subtract 1 from the Objective Control characteristic of models in that enemy model's unit (to a minimum of l).
toyingwiththeprey.text:
WHEN: Fight phase, just after a WYCH CULT unit from your army has fought.

TARGET: That WYCH CULT unit.

EFFECT: If your unit destroyed one or more enemy models this phase, select one of those enemy models. Until the end of your opponent’s next turn, subtract 1 from the Objective Control characteristic of models in that enemy model's unit (to a minimum of l).
toyingwiththeprey.flavour: More than simply besting their victims in combat, the Wyches slowly take them apart, one perfectly placed cut and slice at a time, making a terrifying example to shatter enemy morale.

noobstacle.name: NO OBSTACLE
noobstacle.target: One WYCH CULT unit from your army that opened a Hatchway this turn.
noobstacle.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit can declare a charge that includes one or more targets that are not visible to it, provided each of those units that are not visible to it are wholly on the opposite side of that Hatchway from your unit.
noobstacle.text:
WHEN: Your Charge phase.

TARGET: One WYCH CULT unit from your army that opened a Hatchway this turn.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, your unit can declare a charge that includes one or more targets that are not visible to it, provided each of those units that are not visible to it are wholly on the opposite side of that Hatchway from your unit.
noobstacle.flavour: Scenting their prey's fear sweat, tracking their fluttering heartbeats, the Wyches beardown unerringly on their victims through corridors and chambers.

phantasmgrenades.name: PHANTASM GRENADES
phantasmgrenades.when: Your Movement phase, just after a WYCH CULT unit from your army ends a Normal move, before any enemy units fire Overwatch.
phantasmgrenades.effect: Select one enemy unit within 9" of and visible to your unit. That enemy unit must take a Battle-shock test, subtracting 1 from the result: if failed, until the end of the turn, that enemy unit cannot fire Overwatch.
phantasmgrenades.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase, just after a WYCH CULT unit from your army ends a Normal move, before any enemy units fire Overwatch.

TARGET: That WYCH CULT unit.

EFFECT: Select one enemy unit within 9" of and visible to your unit. That enemy unit must take a Battle-shock test, subtracting 1 from the result: if failed, until the end of the turn, that enemy unit cannot fire Overwatch.
phantasmgrenades.flavour: These hallucinogenic atomisers spew clouds of nightmare-inducing gasses that leave the foe glassy-eyed and reeling.

horrifyingform.name: HORRIFYING FORM
horrifyingform.when: End of any phase, when an objective marker Secured by your army would be Seized by an enemy unit.
horrifyingform.target: One HAEMONCULUS COVENS unit from your army within range of that objective marker.
horrifyingform.effect: Until the end of your next turn, while you have one or more DRUKHARI units within range of that objective marker (excluding Battle-shocked units), that objective marker remains Secured by your army and cannot be Seized by enemy units.
horrifyingform.restrictions: You can only use this Stratagem once per battle round.
horrifyingform.text:
WHEN: End of any phase, when an objective marker Secured by your army would be Seized by an enemy unit.

TARGET: One HAEMONCULUS COVENS unit from your army within range of that objective marker.

EFFECT: Until the end of your next turn, while you have one or more DRUKHARI units within range of that objective marker (excluding Battle-shocked units), that objective marker remains Secured by your army and cannot be Seized by enemy units.

RESTRICTIONS: You can only use this Stratagem once per battle round.
horrifyingform.flavour: The hulking monsters of the Haemonculus Covens are terrifying indeed, cowing enemy warriors with their grotesque and intimidating forms.

unfeelingabominations.name: UNFEELING ABOMINATIONS
unfeelingabominations.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
unfeelingabominations.target: One HAEMONCULUS COVENS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
unfeelingabominations.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6, adding 1 if your unit has the GROTESQUES keyword: on a 4+, do not remove the destroyed model from play; it can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.
unfeelingabominations.restrictions: If your unit has the GROTESQUES keyword, until the end of the phase, it loses the Mindless Killing Machines ability.
unfeelingabominations.text:
WHEN: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One HAEMONCULUS COVENS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6, adding 1 if your unit has the GROTESQUES keyword: on a 4+, do not remove the destroyed model from play; it can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.

RESTRICTIONS: If your unit has the GROTESQUES keyword, until the end of the phase, it loses the Mindless Killing Machines ability.
unfeelingabominations.flavour: The creations of the Haemonculi are capable of enduring terrible wounds and continuing to fight.

mouldedmusculature.name: MOULDED MUSCULATURE
mouldedmusculature.target: One HAEMONCULUS COVENS unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
mouldedmusculature.effect: Select any number of models in your unit. Until the end of the phase, improve the Strength and Armour Penetration characteristics of melee weapons equipped by the selected models by 1, and each time you select targets for attacks made by those models, they must target an enemy unit that is wholly on the opposite side of a Hatchway from them.
mouldedmusculature.text:
WHEN: Fight phase.

TARGET: One HAEMONCULUS COVENS unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.

EFFECT: Select any number of models in your unit. Until the end of the phase, improve the Strength and Armour Penetration characteristics of melee weapons equipped by the selected models by 1, and each time you select targets for attacks made by those models, they must target an enemy unit that is wholly on the opposite side of a Hatchway from them.
mouldedmusculature.flavour: The muscular fleshcraft monstrosities fielded by the Haemonculi can punch through hatchways and bulkheads to reach their cowering victims.

terrifyingaura.name: TERRIFYING AURA
terrifyingaura.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
terrifyingaura.target: One HAEMONCULUS COVENS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks and is within 6" of the attacking unit.
terrifyingaura.effect: That enemy unit must take a Leadership test, subtracting 1 if it is within 3" of your unit: if failed, until the end of the phase, each time a model in that enemy unit makes an attack that targets your unit, an unmodified Hit roll of 6 is required to score a hit, irrespective of the attacking weapon’s Ballistic Skill or any modifiers.
terrifyingaura.text:
WHEN: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One HAEMONCULUS COVENS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks and is within 6" of the attacking unit.

EFFECT: That enemy unit must take a Leadership test, subtracting 1 if it is within 3" of your unit: if failed, until the end of the phase, each time a model in that enemy unit makes an attack that targets your unit, an unmodified Hit roll of 6 is required to score a hit, irrespective of the attacking weapon’s Ballistic Skill or any modifiers.
terrifyingaura.flavour: The disturbing nature of these creatures causes weapons to quiver, even in the hands of veteran soldiers.
